items.title: 〈鴻騰科技日〉盧松青：AI需求不錯產能滿載 光通訊產品明年進一步放量
items.title_en: Foxconn Tech Day – Lu Songqing: AI demand is solid, capacity fully utilized; optical communication products to ramp up further next year
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)旗下鴻騰精密(FIT)(6088-HK)董事長盧松青今(16)日表示，目前AI需求能見度仍好，整體產能相對滿載，延續至明年都不是問題；光通訊今年已經有產品進入，預期明年進一步放量。
鴻騰精密全球首席運營長兼首席財務長盧柏卿表示，光通訊產品雖然毛利率較高，但因目前營收基數仍不大，因此2026年對整體毛利率的影響非常小，2027年開始放量後，影響才會明顯增加。
盧柏卿指出，光通訊市場目前仍處於發展初期，未來成長速度仍取決於整體市場的採用程度，以及不同技術路線的發展，目前相關技術方案仍未完全定案。鴻騰目前已經做好準備，已有一定的量，產能也已預留。
在產品發展方面，盧松青表示，鴻騰在CPO可以從Chip-level切入，包括OE Engine Socket；若從板子直接接出來，則可提供Detachable Connector。目前相關產品仍沒有明確標準，公司也已與多方展開專案。
盧松青指出，從整體技術發展來看，CPO雖然被視為終極方向，但技術難度較高，NPO目前對客戶而言相對有把握；不同方案在Connection System、Support System及Thermal Solution上也有所差異，最終仍要看CSP採用方向。
盧柏卿指出，市場對光的採用並非20%、30%的成長，而是可能以倍數方式增加，因此公司將觀察2027年初整個產業對光的採用及需求程度，再適時做更大的投資布局。
盧松青表示，技術路線目前尚未完全明朗，但長期而言，隨著AI運算需求持續提升，走到後面一定需要光；現階段市場就像一個蹺蹺板，仍在銅與光之間尋找適合的技術方案。
paras_en: Hong Hai (2317-TW) subsidiary Hon Teng Precision (FIT) (6088-HK) chairman Lu Songqing said today (16) that AI demand visibility remains good, overall capacity is relatively fully utilized, and extending into next year is not a problem; optical communication already has products entering the market this year, and is expected to further scale up next year.

Hon Teng Precision global COO and CFO Lu Boqing said that although optical communication products have higher gross margins, because the current revenue base is still small, the impact on overall gross margin in 2026 will be very minimal; the impact will become noticeably larger after scaling up starting in 2027.

Lu Boqing noted that the optical communication market is still in its early development stage, and future growth speed depends on overall market adoption and the development of different technology routes; currently related technical solutions are not yet finalized. Hon Teng is already prepared, has a certain volume, and capacity has been reserved.

Regarding product development, Lu Songqing said Hon Teng can enter CPO from the chip level, including OE Engine Socket; if connecting directly from the board, it can provide Detachable Connector. Currently related products have no clear standards, and the company has already launched projects with multiple parties.

Lu Songqing pointed out that from overall technology development, CPO is seen as the ultimate direction but is technically more challenging, while NPO is currently more reliable for customers; different solutions also differ in Connection System, Support System, and Thermal Solution, and ultimately it depends on the CSP adoption direction.

Lu Boqing indicated that market adoption of optics is not a 20% or 30% growth, but could increase multiples; therefore the company will observe the industry's adoption and demand for optics in early 2027 and then make larger investment allocations in due time.

Lu Songqing said the technology routes are not yet fully clear, but in the long term, as AI computing demand continues to rise, optics will inevitably be needed later; currently the market is like a seesaw, still searching between copper and optics for suitable technology solutions.

items.title: 國科會：法令著重「人類自主」降低AI風險 首年已培育14萬AI人才達標
items.title_en: NSC: Laws Emphasize “Human Autonomy” to Reduce AI Risks, First Year Trains 140,000 AI Talent Meeting Target
paras: 國科會今(16)日召開第23次委員會議，由國發會報告「AI新十大建設推動方案-AI人才生態系推動情形」，展現政府整合教育、實作與全球攬才等建構AI人才生態系之階段性成果，目前台灣AI人才已達14萬人達標。另針對AI發展風險升溫，國科會主委吳誠文表示，AI基本法法令中以「人類自主」為原則，發展及應用應確保由人類掌握自主權，AI消滅人類僅為假議題。
國發會報告中指出，AI快速發展帶動人才需求攀升，政府擴大AI人才培育，規劃每年培育約10萬人次，目標在2028年可累計達40萬人次，今(2026)年已經超過原定目標，達到14萬人次，未來將從校園教育、產業訓練及全球攬才三方面布局，培養AI專業及跨域應用人才。
國發會說，面對全球AI浪潮及產業轉型需求，政府從校園育才到全球攬才，整合教育、產業與社會資源，打造支撐產業發展的AI人才生態系，如校園內，中小學強化AI素養及應用能力，大專院校則建置貼近產業需求的實作場域，鏈結教學能量與產業聚落，培育實戰型AI人才，並透過大專院校AI學程聯盟(TAICA)，整合跨校課程與師資資源。
校園外則推「AI產業人才認定指引3.0」，促進培訓、認證與企業用才需求接軌，並加強中小微企業AI人才培訓與導入應用支持，加速百工百業轉型及創新升級。
此外，近期國外科技業人士主張應放緩AI發展腳步，包括Anthropic新創公司的創辦人呼籲，AI可能對人類構成風險的憂慮升溫，應強制設置AI「緊急關機」機制。
吳誠文回應，目前「AI基本法」已納入7項基本原則及相關風險防範機制，其中「人類自主」是重要原則，發展及應用應確保由人類掌握自主權，並已透過相關機制降低潛在風險。
吳誠文強調，只要確實落實人類自主原則，並透過各種機制防範風險，AI消滅人類，他認為其實只是個假議題。
paras_en: The National Science Council held its 23rd committee meeting today (the 16th), where the National Development Council reported on the “Top Ten AI Construction Initiatives – AI Talent Ecosystem Promotion.” The report showcased the government’s phased achievements in building an AI talent ecosystem through integrated education, hands‑on practice, and global talent recruitment, noting that Taiwan now has 140,000 AI‑qualified personnel. Regarding rising AI‑related risks, NSC chair Wu Cheng‑wen said the AI Basic Law is founded on the principle of “human autonomy,” requiring that development and application remain under human control, and that the notion of AI wiping out humanity is a false issue.

The NDC report highlighted that rapid AI development is driving soaring talent demand. The government has expanded AI talent cultivation, planning to train about 100,000 people each year with a goal of reaching 400,000 cumulative trainees by 2028. In 2026, the target was already exceeded, achieving 140,000 trainees. Future efforts will be deployed across three fronts: campus education, industry training, and global talent recruitment, to nurture both AI specialists and cross‑disciplinary application experts.

The NDC explained that, in response to the global AI wave and industry transformation needs, the government is linking campus talent development with global recruitment, integrating education, industry, and societal resources to build an AI talent ecosystem that supports industrial growth. Within schools, primary and secondary education will strengthen AI literacy and application skills, while universities will establish practice‑oriented environments aligned with industry needs, linking teaching capacity with industrial clusters to produce battle‑ready AI talent. The university AI curriculum alliance (TAICA) will further integrate cross‑institution courses and faculty resources.

Outside the campus, the “AI Industry Talent Certification Guidelines 3.0” are being promoted to align training, certification, and corporate talent needs, while enhancing AI training and implementation support for small and micro‑enterprises, accelerating the transformation and innovative upgrading of all sectors of the economy.

In addition, recent comments from overseas tech industry figures have called for slowing AI development. The founder of the startup Anthropic, for example, warned that concerns about AI posing risks to humanity are intensifying and urged the mandatory implementation of an AI “emergency shut‑off” mechanism.

Wu Cheng‑wen responded that the current “AI Basic Law” already incorporates seven fundamental principles and related risk‑mitigation mechanisms, with “human autonomy” being a key principle. Development and application must ensure that humans retain control, and the law’s mechanisms have already reduced potential risks.

Wu Cheng‑wen emphasized that as long as the principle of human autonomy is genuinely implemented and various mechanisms are used to guard against risks, the idea that AI will eradicate humanity is, in his view, merely a false issue.

items.title: 新光三越周年慶10/1開打 打造全台寶可夢盛會 估業績衝破194億元
items.title_en: Shin Kong Mitsukoshi Anniversary Sale Kicks Off on Oct 1, Creating a Nationwide Pokémon Festival and Targeting Over NT$19.4 Billion in Sales
paras: 百貨龍頭新光三越今(16)日宣布，2026 周年慶首波由全台六大店點將於10月1日起正式開跑，今年以打造全台最好玩的周年慶為號召，從10月到12月、從北到南，將購物、收藏和玩樂到打卡全面串聯，並攜手邁入30周年的寶可夢打造全台寶可夢盛會，全檔期目標業績超過194億元，年增3%。
新光三越表示，今年打造的寶可夢周年慶盛會以皮卡丘、快龍、卡比獸、伊布首度擔綱新光三越周年慶電視廣告主角，並推出全台首輛新光三越周年慶寶可夢30周年主題列車，串聯超過70場見面會、30周年大遊行、Pokemon GO 限定活動、57張巨型卡牌、立體寶可夢展示物等，目標吸引龐大的玩家到訪，進而創造龐大消費商機。
除了好玩，今年新光三越周年慶從「回饋」到「商品」全面加碼，攜手超過 6,000個品牌夥伴推出會員點數回饋，包括化妝品單筆滿 2,000送2,000點、全館累計滿5,000 送5,000點，首七日skm pay 限定名品/大家電/法雅客/iStore 單筆刷1萬送10,000點，更擴大攜手百大品牌推出購買指定組合或消費達檻，再加贈指定 skm points。
同時，為歡慶金卡會員上線滿一周年，新光三越針對金卡會員推出超過20大品牌專屬優惠，讓回饋從「大家都有」進階至「會員真正需要」。
新光三越進一步表示，首波周年慶全台有超過50家新櫃、快閃店進駐，其中，台中中港店 B2 樓層改裝引進19家新品牌，且5家是百貨首見。
而台北南西店今年最大的亮點在於歷經超過半年籌備、完成近 20年來最大幅度改装，從一館B1至4F到三館全面調整，累計有超過 100櫃全新登場，其中，一館強化輕奢與音氛，B1 鎖定18 至35歲年輕客群，三館則擴大日韓潮流陣容。
paras_en: Shin Kong Mitsukoshi, the leading department store chain, announced today (the 16th) that the first wave of its 2026 anniversary celebrations will launch on October 1 across its six flagship stores nationwide. The campaign, billed as the most fun anniversary event in Taiwan, will run from October through December, linking shopping, collecting and play‑to‑share experiences from north to south, and will partner with the 30th‑anniversary Pokémon celebration to create a Taiwan‑wide Pokémon festival, with a full‑period sales target of more than NT$19.4 billion, a 3% year‑over‑year increase.

This year’s Pokémon anniversary festival will feature Pikachu, Dragonite, Snorlax and Eevee as the first‑time protagonists in Shin Kong Mitsukoshi’s TV ads. The retailer will also debut Taiwan’s first anniversary‑themed Pokémon 30th‑anniversary train, tie together over 70 fan‑meet events, a 30th‑anniversary parade, exclusive Pokémon GO activities, 57 giant cards and three‑dimensional Pokémon displays, aiming to draw massive crowds of players and generate substantial consumer spending opportunities.

Beyond the fun factor, the anniversary sale is boosting “rewards” and “merchandise” alike. Shin Kong Mitsukoshi is collaborating with more than 6,000 brand partners to offer member‑point rebates, such as 2,000 points for a single cosmetics purchase of NT$2,000, 5,000 points for a total spend of NT$5,000 across the whole store, and a limited‑time SKM Pay promotion during the first seven days that gives 10,000 points for a single purchase of NT$10,000 on selected luxury goods, major appliances, Falak, or iStore. The program also expands cooperation with the top 100 brands to grant additional SKM points when customers buy designated bundles or meet spending thresholds.

To celebrate the first anniversary of its Gold Card membership, Shin Kong Mitsukoshi is offering exclusive discounts from more than 20 major brands, elevating benefits from “everyone gets something” to “members get what they truly need.”

The retailer added that the first wave of the anniversary celebration will see over 50 new counters and pop‑up shops open across Taiwan. In Taichung’s Zhonggang store, the B2 floor will be renovated to host 19 new brands, five of which are debuting in a department store for the first time.

The biggest highlight at the Taipei South‑West store this year is a massive renovation—the most extensive in the past 20 years—after more than six months of preparation. The overhaul spans from B1 to the 4th floor of Hall 1 and the entire Hall 3, introducing over 100 brand new counters. Hall 1 will strengthen its “light‑luxury” and atmospheric vibe, targeting customers aged 18‑35, while Hall 3 will expand its Japanese and Korean fashion lineup.

items.title: 東洋Lipo-AB海外需求旺 Q4新產線啟動產能提升2倍
items.title_en: Toyo Lipo-AB Sees Strong Overseas Demand; Q4 New Production Line to Triple Capacity
paras: 東洋(4105-TW)今(16)日召開法說會，總經理侯靜蘭指出，旗下微脂體Lipo-AB持續穩定銷往美國，今年也取得澳洲、沙烏地阿拉伯及約旦藥證，明年開始貢獻業績。為因應全球區油，六堵廠去年新增的凍乾產線預計第四季啟動生產，屆時產能將較現有提升2倍。
侯靜蘭表示，Lipo-AB於美國市場銷售亮眼，為近年重要成長的產品，今年陸續取得澳洲、沙烏地阿拉伯及約旦藥證，正在進行銷售通路及鋪貨，預期明年開始貢獻業績，其中，澳洲市場最快明年第一季貢獻。同時也積極布局東南亞市場，預計明後年取得藥證。
侯靜蘭提到，為因應美國及未來其他市場需求，六堵廠去年新增的凍乾產線預計第四季啟動生產，屆時產能將較現階段提升2倍。
第三代EGFR標靶口服肺癌新藥普肺康為另一營運亮點，侯靜蘭指出，今年初取得藥證後，於8月1日納入健保給付，目標於1年內完成醫學中心進藥。另外，今年也將陸續啟動4項臨床試驗，以拓展不同患者使用的機會。
新產品方面，侯靜蘭則表示，授權引進的Xpovio已有多發性骨髓瘤適應症，目前正申請第二項適應症；自行開發的血液癌症及乳癌產品則預計未來2至3年陸續上市。
抗生素部分，Bobimixyn持續成長，而今年新取得藥證的Cubiyo、Tedizolid也將陸續供貨，預期將挹注下半年與明年業績。另有2項抗生素及1項止痛藥正在開發，預計2至3年於台灣上市。
疫苗方面，侯靜蘭表示，佐劑流感疫苗適應症已擴大至50歲以上，政府明年公費加強型流感疫苗採購量，預計由今年20萬劑增至60萬劑，東洋為供應商之一有望受惠。此外，也積極爭取水痘疫苗納入公費疫苗，盼成為繼流感疫苗後第2項公費疫苗產品。
paras_en: Toyo (4105‑TW) held an earnings briefing today (16th). General manager Hou Jing‑lan said its micro‑liposome Lipo‑AB continues to be sold steadily to the United States and this year has also obtained drug approvals in Australia, Saudi Arabia and Jordan, which will start contributing to revenue next year. To meet global demand, the freeze‑dry line added to the Liudu plant last year is slated to start production in Q4, at which point capacity will be three times the current level.

Hou noted that Lipo‑AB’s sales in the U.S. market have been impressive, making it a key growth product in recent years. After securing approvals in Australia, Saudi Arabia and Jordan this year, the company is working on distribution channels and stocking, expecting the product to begin contributing to earnings next year, with the Australian market expected to deliver the first contribution in Q1 2025. The firm is also actively expanding into Southeast Asia, aiming to obtain approvals in the next one to two years.

Hou explained that to satisfy demand from the United States and future markets, the freeze‑dry line added to the Liudu plant last year will commence production in Q4, boosting capacity to twice the current level.

The third‑generation EGFR‑targeted oral lung‑cancer drug Pufei‑kang is another operational highlight. Hou said that after receiving approval early this year, it was added to the national health insurance reimbursement list on August 1, with a goal of achieving hospital‑wide adoption within a year. Additionally, four clinical trials will be launched this year to broaden its use across different patient groups.

Regarding new products, Hou said the licensed introduction of Xpovio already covers multiple myeloma indications and a second indication is currently being filed. Internally developed blood‑cancer and breast‑cancer products are expected to launch over the next two to three years.

In the antibiotics segment, Bobimixyn continues to grow, and the newly approved Cubiyo and Tedizolid will be supplied gradually this year, expected to boost second‑half‑year and next‑year results. Two other antibiotics and one analgesic are under development, with plans to launch in Taiwan within two to three years.

On vaccines, Hou noted that the adjuvanted flu vaccine indication has been expanded to adults aged 50 and over. The government will increase its procurement of enhanced‑efficacy flu vaccines next year from 200,000 doses this year to 600,000 doses, and Toyo, as one of the suppliers, stands to benefit. The company is also actively seeking inclusion of a varicella vaccine in the public‑funded program, hoping to make it the second publicly funded vaccine after the flu vaccine.

items.title: 瑞銀論壇規模創新高 AI需求強勁看旺至2027年 電力與記憶體成主要瓶頸
paras: 第22屆瑞銀台灣論壇盛大登場，吸引逾300名全球投資者與65家台灣供應鏈企業共襄盛舉。瑞銀指出，AI需求至2027年持續強勁，產業成長重心逐漸由GPU訓練延伸至推理運算、ASIC及機櫃級解決方案，帶動液冷與電力分配需求。目前產業發展瓶頸仍為電力輸送能力與記憶體等關鍵零組件供應，而非終端需求，供需吃緊狀況預期延續至2027年，規模較大的供應商有望受惠於採購優勢，進一步提升市佔率。
已舉辦超過20屆的瑞銀台灣論壇，今年共有超過300位全球投資人及65家台灣優質企業參與，一對一與小組會議總數超過400場，參會人數與會議總數雙雙刷新歷史紀錄。
瑞銀證券台北分公司總經理暨瑞銀台灣全球金融市場證券部主管宋鼎文表示，瑞銀20多年來持續將全球投資人帶到台灣，隨著台股表現亮眼，MSCI最近持續上調台灣比重，新增成分股涵蓋記憶體、載板等零組件，顯見國際資金對台灣市場的關注領域持續擴展。

論壇首日討論聚焦AI基礎設施、伺服器、電源及零組件供應鏈。企業普遍認為，AI基礎設施下一階段的成長動力正轉向推理部署、客製化晶片（ASIC）及更高價值量的機櫃級產品。客戶決策已由伺服器層級轉向機櫃層級，進一步為液冷系統、電力分配、分流管、母排及系統整合等環節創造龐大商機。此外，大多數企業看好推理平台滲透率提升、Vera Rubin平台自第4季起加速放量，客製化晶片及ASIC業務增速也有望快於整體伺服器市場。
在產業挑戰方面，瑞銀與參會企業皆指出，未來發生的主要限制因素來自電力輸送能力與伺服器記憶體供應。隨著AI平台的機櫃功率需求大幅提升，電源IC及半導體供應依然吃緊，加速了液冷、DC-DC轉換及高壓直流架構的普及。
另一方面，記憶體供需緊張狀況預計將持續至2027年，由於規模較小的競爭對手難以取得充足零組件，大型製造商可憑藉採購規模優勢，帶動產業集中度提升並進一步擴大市場占有率。

items.title: 三三會籲政府應更積極「搶人才」 能源與人才短缺是國安與經濟韌性課題
items.title_en: SANSAN Association Urges Government to Be More Proactive in "Talent Snatching"; Energy and Talent Shortages Are National Security and Economic Resilience Issues
paras: 三三企業交流會今(16)日舉行9月例會，三三會理事長林伯豐表示，受AI產業帶動台灣經濟上揚，今(2026)年預估經濟成長率約11.05％，但傳統產業仍承受沉重壓力，在歷年發布的《台灣白皮書》與《年度建議書》中，均將「電力供應(能源)」與「人才短缺列為台灣急需解決的國安與經濟韌性課題，他也代表產業界呼籲政府應「搶人才」，而非僅是「留人才」，放寬外籍人才資格、簡化簽證與工作許可程序。
三三會今日中午召開例會，林伯豐致詞時表示，政府連續10年調漲基本工資，月薪累計上漲47.4％、時薪63.3％，今年經濟成長率預估11.05％，主要受AI產業蓬勃阿發展影響，但傳產仍受沉重壓力，目前預期明(2027)年基本月薪調漲下，也預期推升勞健保等企業成本，占約20％支出，三三會呼籲最低工資調漲，應能考慮物價漲幅不超過3％，並持續對加薪分紅的企業給予獎勵補助。
林伯峰指出，近年來隨著AI資料中心、半導體先進製程與高效能運算在台灣快速擴張，台灣美國商會與歐洲商會發布的資料，均將「電力供應(能源)」與「人才短缺」列為台灣急需解決的國安與經濟韌性課題。
三三會建議政府，應建立「多元能源及穩定供電」的務實政策，持續推動核電與綠電並重發展，將核能作為基載電力，積極推動核2、核3重啟，導入新世代核能技術興建新核電廠包括SMR。
針對缺工問題，林伯豐認為，台灣需要更積極「搶人才」，而不只是「留人才」，政府也應放寬外籍專業人才資格、簡化簽證與工作許可程序，來透過稅制優惠與改善住房政策，打造更友善的環境。
paras_en: The SANSAN Business Exchange held its September meeting today (the 16th). Chairman Lin Bo-feng said that driven by the AI industry, Taiwan’s economy is expected to grow about 11.05% this year (2026), but traditional industries still face heavy pressure. In the repeatedly published “Taiwan White Paper” and “Annual Recommendations,” both “power supply (energy)” and “talent shortage” are listed as urgent national‑security and economic‑resilience challenges. Representing industry, Lin called on the government to “snatch talent” rather than merely “retain talent,” by loosening qualifications for foreign talent and simplifying visa and work‑permit procedures.

At today’s noon meeting, Lin Bo-feng noted that the government has raised the basic wage for ten consecutive years, with cumulative monthly salary increases of 47.4% and hourly wages up 63.3%. This year’s growth forecast of 11.05% is mainly due to the booming AI sector, yet traditional sectors remain under strain. With the basic monthly wage expected to rise again in 2027, corporate costs such as labor and health insurance are projected to rise about 20% of expenditures. The SANSAN Association urges that minimum‑wage hikes consider price inflation not exceeding 3% and that companies that share raises with employees continue to receive reward subsidies.

Lin Bo-feng pointed out that in recent years, as AI data centers, advanced semiconductor processes and high‑performance computing rapidly expand in Taiwan, data from the American Chamber of Commerce in Taiwan and the European Chamber both list “power supply (energy)” and “talent shortage” as urgent national‑security and economic‑resilience issues for the island.

The SANSAN Association recommends that the government adopt pragmatic policies for “diverse energy and stable power supply,” continuing to promote both nuclear and renewable energy. Nuclear power should serve as baseload electricity, with active efforts to restart Units 2 and 3 and to introduce next‑generation nuclear technologies, including the construction of new plants such as small modular reactors (SMRs).

Regarding the labor shortage, Lin Bo-feng believes Taiwan must more aggressively “snatch talent” rather than merely “retain talent.” The government should relax qualifications for foreign professional talent, simplify visa and work‑permit procedures, and use tax incentives and improved housing policies to create a more welcoming environment.

items.title: 研調：AI伺服器帶動2026年全球資料中心電力需求年增31% 2028年電網供應缺口擴大
items.title_en: Research: AI Servers Drive 31% Annual Growth in Global Data Center Power Demand by 2026, Grid Supply Gap Expands by 2028
paras: 根據研調機構TrendForce最新AI伺服器產業研究，為滿足AI應用需求，CSP加速部署相關基礎設施，估算今年全球資料中心電力需求容量將達年增31%，主要成長來源為AI伺服器，約占整體需求容量33.4%。TrendForce也估算，自今年起電網供需將開始背離，並在2028年放大。
TrendForce將資料中心電力需求容量分為四大來源，包括通用型伺服器、AI伺服器、其他IT設備，以及非IT設備，其中非IT設備涵蓋散熱及供電系統等。
TrendForce觀察，2025年全球資料中心電力需求容量已達122.9GW，預估今年將上市至161GW，並指出2027年在CSP持續擴大資本支出下，且整體伺服器出貨暢旺，資料中心電力需求容量將維持30%以上的成長速度。
從整體資料中心電力需求容量比重來看，TrendForce表示，AI伺服器比重今年將成長至33.4%，預估明年可能突破40%，通用型伺服器比重將從過去約40%，明年將下滑至25.6%。
TrendForce表示，儘管資料中心機電效率的改善壓低了每單位IT用電所帶動的負載，但隨著以AI server為首的IT設備快速布建，以及非IT設備總需求容量同步成長，促使資料中心開始規劃採用高壓直流供電(HVDC)，以優化整體供配電鏈路效率。
不過TrendForce認為，在資料中心用電需求成長的同時，電網的供電速度尚未跟上，認為在2025年以前，電網可交付能力(Grid Deliverability)尚能滿足需求，但自今年起供需開始背離，並預估在2028年後需求容量缺口將明顯放大。
TrendForce進一步指出，預估2030年全球資料中心電力需求容量將達490.7GW，在其他用電需求全數滿足的前提下，電網可供資料中心使用的容量為222.6GW，供需缺口達268GW。
TrendForce分析，這項供需落差需分兩個層面理解。第一，資料中心的電力需求除了由電網供應，也可能透過業者的表後自建發電獲得滿足，但這部分不計入電網可供資料中心使用的容量，因此上述估計方法無法反映其填補缺口的作用，造成帳面落差高於實際短缺。第二，電網併網與輸配電建設的交付遞延，則會造成實質的供電短缺。
TrendForce指出，以目前資料中心部署量最高的美國來看，預期在2028年以前，由於相當部分的資料中心用電是由業者自建供電與既有機房承接，在國家電網排定的專案幾乎都能準時通電。
但2028年開始，電網交付遞延的情況將更加明顯，成為資料中心電力供給、需求容量落差加大的主因。從現有電網資料觀察，至2030年為止，預估美國資料中心電力供給、需求容量落差將超過170GW，這個缺口後續能否透過表後自建供電、電網供電情況改善而縮小，仍待觀察。
paras_en: According to the latest AI server industry research by research firm TrendForce, to meet AI application demand, cloud service providers (CSPs) are accelerating deployment of related infrastructure, and it estimates that global data‑center power demand capacity will grow by 31% year‑over‑year this year, with the main growth coming from AI servers, which account for about 33.4% of total demand capacity. TrendForce also estimates that grid supply‑demand will begin to diverge starting this year and will widen by 2028.

TrendForce divides data‑center power demand capacity into four major sources: general‑purpose servers, AI servers, other IT equipment, and non‑IT equipment, the latter covering cooling and power‑supply systems among others.

TrendForce observes that global data‑center power demand capacity will reach 122.9 GW in 2025 and is projected to rise to 161 GW this year, noting that in 2027, with CSPs continuing to expand capital expenditures and overall server shipments remaining robust, data‑center power demand capacity will maintain a growth rate of over 30%.

Looking at the share of total data‑center power demand capacity, TrendForce says AI servers’ share will grow to 33.4% this year and could break 40% next year, while the share of general‑purpose servers will fall from roughly 40% historically to 25.6% next year.

TrendForce notes that although improvements in data‑center mechanical‑electrical efficiency have reduced the load per unit of IT electricity, the rapid deployment of IT equipment led by AI servers and the simultaneous growth in total demand for non‑IT equipment are prompting data centers to plan the adoption of high‑voltage direct current (HVDC) to optimise overall power‑distribution efficiency.

However, TrendForce believes that while data‑center electricity demand is growing, grid supply speed has not kept pace. It says grid deliverability can meet demand before 2025, but supply‑demand begins to diverge this year, and the demand‑capacity gap is expected to widen markedly after 2028.

TrendForce further projects that global data‑center power demand capacity will reach 490.7 GW by 2030. Assuming all other electricity needs are fully satisfied, the grid can provide 222.6 GW to data centers, leaving a shortfall of 268 GW.

TrendForce analyses that this supply‑demand gap should be understood on two levels. First, data‑center power demand can also be met by on‑site generation after the meter, which is not counted in the grid‑available capacity, so the accounting gap appears larger than the actual shortage. Second, delays in grid interconnection and transmission‑distribution construction cause real power shortages.

TrendForce points out that in the United States, which currently has the highest data‑center deployment, it is expected that before 2028 a substantial portion of data‑center electricity will be supplied by on‑site generation and existing colocation facilities, allowing most grid‑planned projects to be powered on schedule.

But starting in 2028, grid delivery delays will become more pronounced, becoming the main driver of the widening gap between data‑center power supply and demand capacity. Based on existing grid data, the U.S. data‑center supply‑demand gap is projected to exceed 170 GW by 2030, and whether this gap can be narrowed through on‑site generation or improvements in grid supply remains to be seen.

items.title: 散戶熱追資安題材 但做法是買選擇權並拋售現貨
items.title_en: Retail Investors Chase Cybersecurity Theme but Buy Options While Selling Stocks
paras: 近期全球資訊安全類股迎來強勁反彈，Global X 資安 ETF(BUG-US)更錄得有紀錄以來最大的單日漲幅。然而，根據研調機構 Vanda Analytics 的最新報告，散戶投資人在這波行情中雖大幅增加資安股的選擇權交易，卻對個股現貨維持淨賣出，呈現「熱炒選擇權、冷落正股」的特殊現象。
在法人布局方面，法人機構在行情大漲前的持倉相對輕淡。截至 9 月 14 日，Vanda 針對資安類股組合計算的法人買賣權比率分數(Call-Put Ratio Score)降至 -0.27，低於 2017 年以來的歷史中位數，且遠低於今年 1 月的 +0.84，顯示法人對買權的需求自初夏以來便逐漸降溫。
相較之下，散戶的參與極度集中於衍生性商品。過去 5 個交易日中，散戶在 CrowdStrike(CRWD-US)、Palo Alto Networks(PANW-US)與 Zscaler(ZS-US)等資安龍頭股的價外買權(Out-of-the-money Call)成交量，已躍升至歷史前 2% 的高位(第 98 個百分位數)。
然而，現貨資金流向卻背道而馳，散戶在前一交易日分別淨賣出 640 萬美元的 Palo Alto Networks 以及 350 萬美元的 Zscaler 股票。
針對此一市場結構，Vanda Analytics 創新長兼全球市場策略師Viraj Patel指出，數據證明散戶投資人主要利用短天期選擇權參與資安股的飆漲行情，而非直接重新建立現貨個股部位。
Patel認為，這意味著如果資安類股的反彈趨勢持續，目前散戶偏低的現貨持倉，將為未來現貨買盤的回補與擴增留出潛在空間。
paras_en: Recent global cybersecurity stocks have seen a strong rebound, with the Global X Cybersecurity ETF (BUG-US) posting its biggest single‑day gain on record. However, according to the latest report from research firm Vanda Analytics, retail investors have dramatically increased their options trading in cyber stocks during this rally, while maintaining net selling of the underlying shares, creating a “hot options, cold stocks” phenomenon.

On the institutional side, institutions held relatively light positions before the market surge. As of September 14, Vanda’s Call‑Put Ratio Score for the cybersecurity stock basket fell to –0.27, below the historical median since 2017 and far lower than the +0.84 recorded in January, indicating that institutional demand for calls has been cooling since early summer.

In contrast, retail participation is extremely concentrated in derivatives. Over the past five trading days, retail investors’ out‑of‑the‑money call volume on cyber‑security leaders such as CrowdStrike (CRWD‑US), Palo Alto Networks (PANW‑US) and Zscaler (ZS‑US) has jumped into the top 2 % historically (the 98th percentile).

Yet the flow of cash into the underlying stocks moves in the opposite direction: retail investors net‑sold $6.4 million of Palo Alto Networks and $3.5 million of Zscaler shares on the prior trading day.

Commenting on this market structure, Vanda Analytics’ Chief Innovation Officer and Global Market Strategist Viraj Patel said the data show retail investors are mainly using short‑dated options to ride the cyber‑stock rally rather than rebuilding outright equity positions.
Patel believes this implies that if the cybersecurity rebound continues, the currently low retail equity holdings could leave room for future buying pressure and an expansion of spot positions.

items.title: Fed升息早被市場猜中！華許說錯一句話才是真正風險
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)周三(16日)料將升息1碼(25個基點)，為2023年以來首度升息，將聯邦資金利率目標區間上調至3.75%至4.00%。不過，由於市場預期升息機率已超過90%，政策決定本身可能不會帶來太大意外，Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)如何說明此次行動，以及是否暗示後續仍有升息空間，反而將成為牽動全球金融市場的關鍵。
這也將是華許接掌Fed後首次調整貨幣政策，升息決定與美國總統川普原先期待背道而馳。川普提名華許時曾表示，希望他帶領Fed降息，近期更威脅稱，若Fed不降低借貸成本，將祭出新一輪進口關稅。
然而，美國通膨持續高於Fed的2%目標，加上全球借貸成本攀升，市場也質疑華許是否有意願抵抗白宮壓力，使本周升息幾乎已成定局。投資人如今最關注的，是華許能否說服債券市場，相信Fed有決心壓制已連續逾5年高於目標的通膨。

升息是否獲一致支持成關鍵訊號

Fed將於美東時間周三下午2時公布利率決策，並同步發布最新季度經濟預測及利率點陣圖。PGIM美國首席經濟學家Robert Sockin表示，若本次升息獲得決策官員一致支持，將釋出強烈訊號；若經濟預測顯示官員預期今年還會再升息，甚至2027年仍有進一步行動，政策立場將更加明確。
Sockin預期Fed可能共升息3次。他認為，華許上月在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會的說法已為本次行動鋪路，即若通膨未能以足夠速度回落，Fed就還有更多工作要做。
相較之下，若華許將此次升息形容為幅度不大的政策微調，並在記者會上流露鴿派態度，市場反應可能不佳。投資人恐怕會懷疑Fed抗通膨的決心，進而拋售長天期美債，導致殖利率不降反升。
Fed官員6月公布的預測仍存在明顯分歧，19名官員中有9人認為，2026年底前至少需要升息1碼，另有9人預估利率可能維持不變或下降1碼；不喜歡點陣圖制度的華許，則未提交個人預測。
不過，支持升息的聲音此後持續增加。7月28日至29日的決策會議已有3名官員主張升息，另有多名官員表示，除非通膨很快出現降溫跡象，否則已準備採取行動。

通膨居高不下 油價與關稅再添風險

Fed偏好的通膨指標個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數，6月及7月年增率均達3.7%，遠高於2%目標，9月30日公布的最新數據也預料不會出現明顯改善。
雖然許多經濟學家仍認為通膨壓力最終將逐步減弱，但近期國際油價重新站上每桶100美元，加上川普宣布對加拿大加徵新關稅，並威脅推出更多進口稅，以及人工智慧(AI)支出熱潮持續支撐美國經濟成長，都讓通膨上行風險升高。
華許在傑克森霍爾演說中也坦言，決策官員必須確信基礎通膨正明確且以足夠速度朝政策目標邁進，但近期數據尚未顯示通膨趨勢已獲得實質改善。
市場因此認為，此次升息不僅是對當前通膨的回應，也是華許建立抗通膨公信力的重要考驗。一旦Fed在市場已有高度預期的情況下按兵不動，可能加深投資人對華許屈服於政治壓力的疑慮。

華許若不夠鷹 美債殖利率恐不降反升

全球債市走勢也正將Fed推向更高利率。美國10年期公債殖利率周二突破5%，升至19年新高。愈來愈多經濟學家與投資人認為，全球可能已進入借貸成本長期走高的新環境，即使排除通膨及發債風險等因素，均衡利率本身也可能正在上升。
這代表Fed即使只是希望維持相同程度的貨幣緊縮，短期政策利率仍可能需要進一步調高。包括華許在內的多名Fed官員也認為，目前政策對經濟需求的抑制作用並不強。
這或許也是川普政府可能默許Fed升息的原因。若Fed意外打破市場已充分反映的升息預期，可能損害華許的抗通膨信譽，迫使投資人要求更高的通膨風險補償，反而推升長期殖利率。10年期美債殖利率又是房貸等消費信貸的重要定價基準，借貸成本居高不下，恐衝擊共和黨在11月期中選舉力保國會控制權的努力。
不過，渣打銀行(Standard Chartered)分析師John Davies與Steve Englander主張，本周仍應按兵不動，認為市場在新增數據有限的情況下形成「回音室效應」，不斷推高升息預期，而Fed多等待一段時間的代價其實很低。
布魯金斯學會(Brookings Institution)資深研究員Robin Brooks則指出，市場目前已反映明年6月前升息4次，華許勢必在記者會上不斷被追問對此有何看法。若其發言比市場預期鴿派，即使Fed已透過升息試圖穩定殖利率，仍可能引發長天期美債新一輪賣壓。
因此，本次會議真正的風險不在Fed是否升息，而在華許會把它描述為一次性行動、後續升息循環的第一步，或是完全取決於數據的政策調整。升息早已被市場視為定局，華許說出口的每一句話，可能比升息本身更具影響力。

items.title: 華爾街靜待聯準會決策 70%機構預估2026年將升息至少2碼
items.title_en: Wall Street Awaits Fed Decision, 70% of Institutions Forecast at Least Two Rate Hikes by 2026
paras: 美國聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)與聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)將於當地時間周三(16日)公布最新利率決策，市場密切關注道瓊指數、標普500指數及那斯達克綜合指數的潛在劇烈波動。
過去數周，預測市場與芝加哥商品交易所(CME Group)FedWatch 工具顯示的升息機率約各半。然而在8月通膨報告公布後，華爾街預期出現劇烈轉變。
根據《華爾街日報》首席經濟記者Nick Timiraos彙整的20家金融機構預測，僅4家認為今年不會升息；而在預期升息的16家機構中，高達14家(占比70%)預估2026年聯準會將升息50個基點(2碼)至75個基點(3碼)。
華許就任聯準會主席約4個月以來，改革措施包括取消FOMC會議聲明中的前瞻性指引，打破金融市場過去二十多年的習慣，使政策走向更難預估。聯準會上次以50個基點啟動升息循環是在2022年3月，當時標普500指數在隨後3個月內下跌了13%。
市場分析指出，推升通膨的主要動力來自「川普通膨」與人工智慧革命。川普政府的關稅政策與伊朗戰爭(包含荷姆茲海峽遭封鎖導致燃料價格飆升)，正將通膨壓力擴散至能源領域之外，呈現根深蒂固的趨勢。同時，強勁的AI基礎建設需求與硬體短缺，賦予企業極高定價權，進一步推高消費者物價。
面對難以平息的通膨，聯準會預計將採取直接行動，以維護物價穩定。
paras_en: U.S. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh and the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) will announce their latest interest-rate decision on Wednesday (the 16th local time), and markets are closely watching for potentially sharp moves in the Dow Jones Industrial Average, the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite.

In recent weeks, market forecasts and the CME Group’s FedWatch tool have shown roughly a 50-50 chance of a rate hike. However, after the August inflation report was released, Wall Street expects a dramatic shift.

According to chief economics reporter Nick Timiraos of The Wall Street Journal, a compilation of forecasts from 20 financial institutions shows that only four expect no rate hikes this year; among the 16 that do expect hikes, as many as 14 institutions (70%) project that the Fed will raise rates by 50 basis points (two quarters) to 75 basis points (three quarters) by 2026.

Since taking office about four months ago, Chair Warsh has implemented reforms including the removal of forward guidance from FOMC statements, breaking a habit that has persisted in financial markets for more than two decades and making policy paths harder to predict. The Fed last started a tightening cycle with a 50‑basis‑point hike in March 2022, after which the S&P 500 fell 13 % over the following three months.

Market analysts point to “Trump‑era inflation” and the artificial‑intelligence revolution as the main drivers of price pressures. The Trump administration’s tariff policy and the war with Iran (including the closure of the Hormuz Strait that spiked fuel prices) are spreading inflationary pressure beyond the energy sector, creating a deep‑rooted trend. At the same time, strong demand for AI infrastructure and hardware shortages give companies considerable pricing power, further pushing up consumer prices.
Facing stubborn inflation, the Fed is expected to take direct action to preserve price stability.

items.title: 英特爾搶實體AI商機 看好XPU運算分工降成本
items.title_en: Intel Seizes Physical AI Opportunities, Optimistic About XPU Computing Division Reducing Costs
paras: 實體AI正快速萌芽，英特爾(INTC-US)積極搶攻Physical AI與機器人商機，邊緣運算事業群平台研發協理王宗業今(16)日表示，機器人AI並不一定都需要額外配置大型獨立GPU，而可透過CPU、GPU與NPU組成的異構運算(XPU)架構，依不同工作負載進行分工，在滿足AI效能需求之餘，也降低系統功耗與整體持有成本(TCO)。
王宗業指出，AI產業過去幾年焦點多集中於大型語言模型與前沿模型訓練，但現階段市場並不缺模型，真正重要的是「模型如何落地」。隨著AI從雲端走向邊緣，Physical AI也逐漸形成「Sense、Reasoning、Acting」的完整閉環，也就是從感知環境、理解情境，最終進一步控制機器與設備採取實際行動。
其中，Agentic AI將成為Physical AI的重要推手。以智慧交通為例，過去應用主要停留在Traffic Monitoring等電腦視覺辨識，接下來則會逐步加入Sensor Fusion、生成式AI、複雜異常偵測，再透過Agentic AI將不同模型與工具串接，最終由機器人或自動化設備執行實際任務。
王宗業認為，這也意味著未來邊緣AI工作負載會更加多元，單一運算架構難以包辦所有工作，因此Intel採取CPU、GPU與NPU並行的XPU策略。
以機器人為例，CPU可負責Agentic AI、任務排程以及與外部系統溝通；GPU則處理視覺運算、複雜計算以及機器人動作生成；NPU則可負責影像辨識等需要長時間執行、但同時要求低功耗的AI推論工作，讓三種運算單元各司其職。
王宗業強調，在許多邊緣端應用中，處理器內建GPU的效能其實已經足夠，並不需要額外外掛大型獨立GPU。他表示，若只是為了部分AI工作負載額外增加GPU，不僅會提高整機成本，也同步拉高功耗與TCO，但實際帶來的效益未必成比例。
Intel此次也指出，新一代Core Ultra平台整體AI運算能力可達約180至200 TOPS，可望支援約150億至300億參數規模的AI模型，讓更多生成式AI與Agentic AI工作負載直接部署在邊緣設備。
王宗業也以PCB瑕疵檢測機器人為例，說明XPU架構的實際運作方式。機器人可由GPU負責控制手臂與產生動作，NPU同步執行視覺辨識與PCB瑕疵檢測，再由CPU負責任務調度，並將最終結果回傳至工廠製造管理系統，三種運算單元同步工作。
Intel目前邊緣運算業務已橫跨零售、餐飲、教育、醫療、工業製造、運輸及智慧城市等約八至九個垂直市場，機器人及自主移動機器人(AMR)也是Physical AI的重要落地方向。
王宗業透露，目前已有客戶採用Intel CPU搭配ROS 2，開發應用於晶圓廠的自主移動機器人，藉由高精度與高重複性的運作能力切入半導體製造場域，顯示Physical AI已不僅停留在概念驗證階段，而逐步進入實際工業應用。
除了硬體，Intel也試圖透過軟體生態系建立Physical AI的另一道門檻。Intel在2025年推出Open Edge Platform，從底層Platform Software、AI工具與Library一路延伸至Reference Application，讓合作夥伴可以直接在既有架構上開發自身垂直市場解決方案。
在機器人領域，Intel進一步提供Robotic AI Suite、Physical AI Studio及OpenVINO等工具。其中，Robotic AI Suite以ROS 2等開放標準為基礎，降低底層軟硬體整合複雜度；Physical AI Studio則透過圖形化介面簡化資料收集、模型訓練與Fine-tuning流程，可用於教導機器人學習新的操作技能。
至於OpenVINO則鎖定模型完成後的部署最佳化。王宗業表示，透過軟體最佳化，除了可提升AI執行效率，也能進一步縮減系統所需要的儲存容量，例如若終端設備由原本需要128GB Flash降至64GB，就能直接降低量產硬體成本。
王宗業指出，Intel的策略並非建立一套完全封閉的Physical AI系統，而是將過去在運算平台累積的技術轉化成開放生態系，並支援ROS、PyTorch等業界主流開源框架，再由合作夥伴加入自身的導航、機器人演算法及產業Know-how，加速產品商業化。
截至2026年9月，Intel表示，其Open Edge Platform生態系已累積155套經過驗證的系統，來自63家系統供應商，另有125家獨立軟體廠商(ISV)提供137項應用，相關生態系約在一年半內逐步建立。
隨著AI從「會回答問題」走向「能夠執行任務」，Physical AI也成為半導體業者下一波競逐焦點。相較市場目前高度聚焦大型GPU，Intel則企圖以CPU、GPU、NPU異構運算與既有x86、邊緣運算生態系切入，鎖定功耗、成本更加敏感的工業與機器人市場。
paras_en: Physical AI is rapidly emerging, and Intel (INTC-US) is actively pursuing Physical AI and robotics opportunities. Wang Zongye, senior associate director of platform R&D for the Edge Computing Business Group, said today (the 16th) that robot AI does not always require a large standalone GPU; instead, a heterogeneous XPU architecture composed of CPU, GPU, and NPU can allocate tasks according to workload, meeting AI performance needs while lowering system power consumption and overall total cost of ownership (TCO).

Wang noted that in recent years the AI industry has focused on large language models and cutting‑edge model training, but the market now is not lacking models; the real challenge is "how models are deployed." As AI moves from the cloud to the edge, Physical AI is forming a complete loop of "Sense, Reasoning, Acting"—perceiving the environment, understanding the context, and ultimately controlling machines and devices to take concrete actions.

Agentic AI will become a key driver of Physical AI. In smart transportation, for example, applications have so far been limited to computer‑vision tasks such as traffic monitoring. Future steps will add sensor fusion, generative AI, and complex anomaly detection, and then use Agentic AI to stitch together different models and tools, allowing robots or automation equipment to execute real tasks.

Wang believes this means edge AI workloads will become more diverse, and a single compute architecture cannot handle everything, so Intel is adopting an XPU strategy that runs CPU, GPU, and NPU in parallel.

For robots, the CPU can handle Agentic AI, task scheduling, and communication with external systems; the GPU processes visual computing, complex calculations, and robot motion generation; the NPU takes on image‑recognition‑type inference that runs for long periods but requires low power, letting each compute unit focus on its specialty.

Wang emphasized that in many edge applications the built‑in GPU of a processor is already sufficient, and an additional large external GPU is unnecessary. Adding a GPU just for some AI tasks raises the device cost, power draw, and TCO, while the performance gain may not be proportional.

Intel also highlighted that the next‑generation Core Ultra platform can deliver roughly 180‑200 TOPS of AI compute, capable of supporting AI models with 15‑30 billion parameters, enabling more generative and Agentic AI workloads to run directly on edge devices.

Wang illustrated the XPU workflow with a PCB‑defect‑inspection robot. The GPU controls the arm and generates motions, the NPU simultaneously performs visual recognition and defect detection, and the CPU handles task scheduling and sends the final results back to the factory’s manufacturing management system, with all three compute units operating in sync.

Intel’s edge computing business now spans about eight to nine vertical markets—including retail, food service, education, healthcare, industrial manufacturing, transportation, and smart cities—while robotics and autonomous mobile robots (AMR) are key Physical AI deployment areas.

Wang disclosed that customers are already using Intel CPUs together with ROS 2 to develop autonomous mobile robots for semiconductor fabs, leveraging high precision and repeatability to enter the semiconductor manufacturing arena, showing that Physical AI is moving beyond proof‑of‑concept into real industrial use.

Beyond hardware, Intel is building a software ecosystem to raise the barrier for Physical AI. Intel plans to launch the Open Edge Platform in 2025, extending from low‑level platform software and AI tools/libraries to reference applications, allowing partners to develop vertical‑market solutions on existing architectures.

In robotics, Intel offers the Robotic AI Suite, Physical AI Studio, and OpenVINO. The Robotic AI Suite, based on open standards such as ROS 2, reduces the complexity of hardware‑software integration; Physical AI Studio provides a graphical interface to simplify data collection, model training, and fine‑tuning, enabling robots to learn new skills.

OpenVINO focuses on post‑model deployment optimization. Wang said that software optimizations not only boost AI execution efficiency but also cut required storage—for example, reducing a device’s flash requirement from 128 GB to 64 GB directly lowers mass‑production hardware costs.

Wang clarified that Intel’s strategy is not to create a closed‑source Physical AI system, but to turn the computing‑platform technologies accumulated over years into an open ecosystem that supports ROS, PyTorch, and other mainstream open‑source frameworks. Partners can then add their own navigation, robot algorithms, and industry know‑how to accelerate product commercialization.

As of September 2026, Intel reported that its Open Edge Platform ecosystem has validated 155 systems from 63 system suppliers, with 125 independent software vendors (ISVs) offering 137 applications, building the ecosystem over roughly a year and a half.

As AI shifts from "answering questions" to "executing tasks," Physical AI becomes the next competitive focus for semiconductor companies. While the market is currently dominated by large GPUs, Intel aims to capture the more power‑ and cost‑sensitive industrial and robotics segments by leveraging heterogeneous CPU‑GPU‑NPU computing and its existing x86 and edge‑computing ecosystem.

items.title: 高通重構手機AI晶片架構 NPU記憶體容量大增50%
items.title_en: Qualcomm Rebuilds Mobile AI Chip Architecture, NPU Memory Capacity Grows 50%
paras: 隨著代理式AI (Agentic AI)逐步成為手機端AI發展重心，高通(QCOM-US)也重新調整行動晶片架構，新一代頂級行動平台將以全新Qualcomm Hexagon NPU為核心，不僅導入專為Transformer工作負載打造的Element Accelerator，NPU共享記憶體容量更大幅增加50%，藉此降低外部記憶體存取需求，支援更長上下文、多模型協作及並行AI代理運作。
高通指出，代理式AI與過去生成式AI最大的差異，在於未來並非由單一大型模型處理所有任務，而是會依照任務、情境及使用者需求，動態調度不同的專用模型。因此，手機端AI所需要的也不只是更高的推論效能，而是能夠支援持續運作、多模態處理、低延遲及模型協同調度的全新運算架構。
此次新一代Hexagon NPU最大的架構升級之一，就是擴充共享記憶體容量。高通表示，NPU記憶體子系統容量增加50%，讓更多模型狀態、啟用值及中間張量能保留在晶片本地端，減少頻繁存取DDR記憶體的需求，進一步降低記憶體頻寬瓶頸及功耗。
高通指出，隨著AI代理需要處理更長的上下文、更多工具及多項並行任務，記憶體存取效率的重要性持續提升。透過更大的共享記憶體，可讓AI代理以更短等待時間完成回答、修正、規劃與執行動作，同時提升token生成速度，並讓AI代理在不同工具及任務之間切換時更加流暢。
除記憶體架構升級外，高通也在Hexagon NPU中導入全新Element Accelerator，專門加速生成式AI及代理式AI大量採用的Transformer工作負載，並結合向量、矩陣及純量擴充功能，提升大型模型推論及AI代理決策、路由與協同調度效率。
高通同時將混合專家模型（Mixture-of-Experts，MoE）視為未來手機端大型AI模型的重要架構。高通指出，一個擁有300億參數的MoE模型，可保有數百億個參數，但每次生成token時，僅需啟用約30億個經路由選擇的參數。
相較於傳統Dense模型每次推論都需要動用大部分模型參數，MoE可根據輸入內容動態選擇不同專家模型，藉此降低運算量及記憶體頻寬需求，讓更大型的AI模型有機會在手機端運作。
為進一步降低記憶體壓力，高通也導入從快閃記憶體至系統記憶體的專家模型管理及快取機制，可依照實際需求載入不同模型，搭配更大的NPU共享記憶體，提升模型切換效率。
在AI模型精度方面，新一代Hexagon NPU支援INT2、INT4、INT8、FP8及FP16等多種格式，讓開發者可依照效能、記憶體占用、模型品質及功耗需求進行調整。
其中，針對INT4模型，高通表示，新平台可帶來最高50%的預填（Prefill）效能提升，同時改善解碼吞吐量、推測解碼（Speculative Decoding）及整體每秒token數，進一步縮短AI模型處理長篇輸入資料及產生回應所需時間。
高通也強調，在代理式AI架構下，CPU與NPU的協同運作將更加重要。Hexagon NPU主要負責Transformer及AI推論運算，CPU則負責多步驟工作流程中的路由、協同調度及資料管理，確保資料能即時提供給NPU使用。
高通認為，未來行動AI將逐步從單一模型推論，轉向多模型、多代理及持續運作的架構，而新一代Hexagon NPU透過Element Accelerator、更大的共享記憶體、MoE模型支援以及低精度運算能力，目的就是讓更多代理式AI功能直接在裝置端完成，在降低延遲及功耗的同時，也兼顧資料隱私。
paras_en: As agentic AI becomes the focus of mobile AI development, Qualcomm (QCOM-US) has re‑engineered its mobile chip architecture. The next‑generation flagship mobile platform will center on a brand‑new Qualcomm Hexagon NPU, featuring a Transformer‑specific Element Accelerator and a 50% larger shared memory capacity to cut external memory accesses and support longer contexts, multi‑model collaboration, and concurrent AI agents.

Qualcomm notes that the key difference between agentic AI and earlier generative AI is that future tasks will not be handled by a single large model. Instead, different specialized models will be dynamically scheduled based on the task, context, and user needs. Thus, mobile AI requires not just higher inference performance but an entirely new compute architecture that can sustain continuous operation, multimodal processing, low latency, and coordinated model scheduling.

One of the biggest architectural upgrades in the new Hexagon NPU is the expanded shared memory. Qualcomm says the NPU memory subsystem is 50% larger, allowing more model states, activation values, and intermediate tensors to stay on‑chip, reducing frequent DDR accesses, and further easing memory‑bandwidth bottlenecks and power draw.

Qualcomm points out that as AI agents handle longer contexts, more tools, and multiple parallel tasks, memory‑access efficiency becomes ever more critical. The larger shared memory lets agents answer, correct, plan, and execute actions with shorter wait times, speeds up token generation, and makes switching between tools and tasks smoother.

Beyond the memory upgrade, Qualcomm has added a new Element Accelerator to the Hexagon NPU, dedicated to accelerating the Transformer workloads that dominate generative and agentic AI. It combines vector, matrix, and scalar extensions to boost large‑model inference and improve AI‑agent decision‑making, routing, and coordinated scheduling efficiency.

Qualcomm also treats Mixture‑of‑Experts (MoE) models as a key architecture for future large mobile AI models. It explains that a 30‑billion‑parameter MoE model can retain hundreds of billions of parameters, yet only about 3 billion routed parameters are activated for each generated token.

Compared with traditional dense models that mobilize most of their parameters on every inference, MoE can dynamically select different expert sub‑models based on input, reducing compute and memory‑bandwidth demands and making it feasible to run even larger AI models on phones.

To further ease memory pressure, Qualcomm introduces an expert‑model management and caching system that moves models from flash storage to system memory on demand. Coupled with the larger NPU shared memory, this improves model‑switching efficiency.

In terms of model precision, the new Hexagon NPU supports INT2, INT4, INT8, FP8 and FP16 formats, giving developers flexibility to balance performance, memory footprint, model quality, and power consumption.

Specifically for INT4 models, Qualcomm says the new platform can deliver up to a 50% boost in pre‑fill performance, while also improving decode throughput, speculative decoding, and overall tokens‑per‑second, further shortening the time needed to process long inputs and generate responses.

Qualcomm stresses that under an agentic AI architecture, CPU‑NPU collaboration becomes even more important. The Hexagon NPU handles Transformer and AI inference workloads, while the CPU manages routing, coordinated scheduling, and data handling across multi‑step workflows, ensuring data is promptly available to the NPU.

Qualcomm believes mobile AI will evolve from single‑model inference to multi‑model, multi‑agent, and continuous‑operation architectures. The new Hexagon NPU, with its Element Accelerator, larger shared memory, MoE support, and low‑precision compute, aims to enable more agentic AI functions to run directly on devices, reducing latency and power while preserving data privacy.

items.title: 盤前各漲3%、5%！SK海力士又傳出與英特爾合作在美生產記憶體晶片　兩大潛在方案曝光
items.title_en: Pre‑market gains of 3% and 5%: SK Hynix again rumored to partner with Intel to produce memory chips in the US, two potential options disclosed
paras: 美股光通訊族群在美股周三(16日)盤前小幅走高，Coherent、Lumentum漲超2%。此外，英特爾漲約5%，SK海力士漲約3%，因外媒引述知情人士消息最新報導指出，SK海力士正與英特爾洽談在美國生產記憶體晶片，潛在方案包括租用英特爾俄亥俄州晶片廠部分產能，或是與英特爾及大型雲端運算企業成立合資企業，相關談判仍處於探索階段，尚未做出決定。
知情人士透露，SK海力士與英特爾針對在美國境內首次生產記憶體晶片的潛在合作展開談判，討論的方案之一是SK海力士租用英特爾位於俄亥俄州晶片製造設施的部分產能，另一種合作則涉及合資企業。
早在今年7月，市場便傳出SK海力士將買下英特爾在俄亥俄州工廠，但被兩家公司雙雙否認。業內人士當時指出，俄亥俄州仍是英特爾代工業務的核心，因此不可能出售。
目前，SK海力士主要生產DRAM和NAND快閃記憶體，同時也是AI處理器所用高頻寬記憶體(HBM)的主要供應商。
SK海力士今年已完成美股ADR上市，並正在美國印第安納州建造一座晶片封裝工廠。該公司董事長崔泰源今年7月曾稱有必要在美國建廠。
知情人士指出，若在美國生產HBM或DRAM等先進記憶體晶片，恐面臨南韓政府的審查，因上述技術被視為敏感技術。
此前，南韓貿易部曾稱相關決定將由SK海力士自行決定，但涉及國家重要技術的項目恐須依據《產業技術保護法》接受審查。
租用部分產能或建立合資企業則避開這個敏感問題，且擴大SK海力士在美製造規模，有助於該公司爭取川普政府支持。對英特爾而言，這項合作則可以緩解財務壓力。
若涉及DRAM或HBM等先進記憶體技術，恐面臨南韓政府審查。SK海力士表示，正研究包括新增生產基地在內的多種方案，但目前尚未確定具體事項。英特爾則表示將繼續投資俄亥俄州廠區建設。
paras_en: U.S. optical‑communication stocks edged higher in pre‑market trading on Wednesday (the 16th), with Coherent and Lumentum up more than 2%. Intel rose about 5% and SK Hynix about 3% after foreign media, citing sources, reported that SK Hynix is in talks with Intel about producing memory chips in the United States. Potential options include leasing part of Intel’s Ohio fab capacity or forming a joint venture with Intel and a major cloud‑computing company. The negotiations are still exploratory and no decision has been made yet.

Sources said SK Hynix and Intel are negotiating a potential first‑ever U.S. memory‑chip production partnership. One proposal discussed is for SK Hynix to lease part of Intel’s chip‑manufacturing facility in Ohio, while another involves a joint‑venture arrangement.

Back in July this year, the market reported that SK Hynix would buy Intel’s Ohio plant, but both companies denied the rumor. Industry insiders noted that Ohio remains a core site for Intel’s foundry business, making a sale unlikely.
Currently, SK Hynix mainly manufactures DRAM and NAND flash memory and is also a major supplier of high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) used in AI processors.
SK Hynix completed its U.S. ADR listing this year and is building a chip‑packaging plant in Indiana. Chairman Choi Tae‑won said in July that establishing a plant in the United States is necessary.
Sources warned that producing advanced memory chips such as HBM or DRAM in the United States could trigger scrutiny from the South Korean government, as these technologies are considered sensitive.

Earlier, South Korea’s Ministry of Trade had said that SK Hynix would decide on its own, but projects involving nationally important technologies may have to undergo review under the Industrial Technology Protection Act.

Leasing capacity or creating a joint venture would sidestep the sensitivity issue and expand SK Hynix’s U.S. manufacturing footprint, helping the company seek support from the Trump administration. For Intel, the cooperation could ease financial pressure.

If advanced memory technologies like DRAM or HBM are involved, South Korean government review is likely. SK Hynix said it is studying multiple options, including new production sites, but no concrete plan has been set. Intel said it will continue investing in its Ohio facility.

items.title: 英特爾陳立武警告：記憶體短缺將惡化 電力與散熱是下一戰場
items.title_en: Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger Warns Memory Shortage Will Worsen; Power and Cooling Are the Next Battleground
paras: 英特爾(INTC-US) 執行長陳立武示警，隨著人工智慧（AI）基礎建設持續擴張，記憶體短缺問題恐進一步惡化，電力供應與散熱技術也將成為半導體產業面臨的關鍵挑戰。他指出，AI時代的競爭已不再只是晶片效能提升，而是涵蓋整個系統架構與基礎設施能力。
陳立武周二(15日)在加州聖克拉拉舉辦的AI基礎設施論壇上表示，記憶體供應不足已成為AI產業的重要瓶頸。他回顧指出，自己去年初便曾提出記憶體可能成為限制AI發展的一大因素，當時市場並未普遍注意，但如今這項問題已經浮現，且情勢仍可能持續惡化。
他表示，記憶體產能相當有限，部分AI相關專案因無法取得足夠記憶體而受到影響，同時記憶體價格已大幅上漲。
隨著GPU等AI處理器在算力提升方面遭遇瓶頸，高頻寬記憶體（HBM）在AI運算中的重要性持續提高。由於AI伺服器需求快速增加，三星電子、SK海力士與美光等主要記憶體廠商的HBM產能仍難以完全滿足需求，加上部分產線轉向生產HBM，也造成通用記憶體供應吃緊。
除了記憶體之外，陳立武也指出，電力供應與冷卻技術將是AI產業下一階段的重要挑戰。
他表示，業界都已意識到電力問題的重要性，未來若要在部分應用場景降低功耗，晶片架構設計與互聯技術將扮演關鍵角色。
散熱方面，他指出，隨著AI運算負載提高，傳統風冷技術可能不足以因應需求，液冷與微流體冷卻等新方案將受到重視。陳立武透露，英特爾目前也正投入多項相關技術研發。
半導體競爭轉向系統級架構
陳立武也呼籲產業關注半導體市場朝系統級架構轉型的趨勢。他指出，輝達與AMD目前正將GPU、CPU、網路元件與軟體整合至完整機架系統，並以整體方案提供給客戶。
他表示，未來產業競爭將不只是單一晶片性能比拚，而是需要從整機機架層級處理運算負載，依照客戶需求提供客製化方案，並與客戶共同合作。他也透露，英特爾將在基板領域推出相關消息。
談及英特爾與輝達(NVDA-US) 的關係，陳立武表示，英特爾將持續維持雙方合作。輝達目前既是英特爾主要股東，也是AI晶片市場的重要競爭者。
他指出，企業不可能涵蓋所有業務領域，關鍵在於選擇自身真正具備優勢的方向，同時與其他企業建立合作關係，以共同推動產業發展。
paras_en: Intel (INTC-US) CEO Pat Gelsinger warned that as AI infrastructure continues to expand, the memory shortage problem could worsen further, and power supply and cooling technology will become critical challenges for the semiconductor industry. He noted that competition in the AI era is no longer just about improving chip performance, but encompasses the entire system architecture and infrastructure capabilities.

Gelsinger said on Tuesday (the 15th) at an AI infrastructure forum in Santa Clara, California, that insufficient memory supply has become a major bottleneck for the AI industry. He recalled that he had warned as early as last year that memory could become a limiting factor for AI development, a concern that was not widely recognized at the time, but that the issue has now surfaced and could continue to deteriorate.
He explained that memory capacity is quite limited, and some AI projects are being impacted because they cannot obtain enough memory, while memory prices have risen sharply.

As GPUs and other AI processors hit performance ceilings, high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) is becoming increasingly important for AI workloads. Rapid growth in AI server demand means that major memory makers such as Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron still cannot fully meet HBM demand, and the shift of some production lines to HBM also tightens the supply of standard memory.
Beyond memory, Gelsinger also highlighted that power supply and cooling technology will be key challenges for the next phase of the AI industry.

He said the industry is already aware of the importance of power issues, and that reducing power consumption in certain application scenarios will depend on chip architecture design and interconnect technologies.

Regarding cooling, he noted that as AI compute loads increase, traditional air‑cooling may be insufficient, and new solutions such as liquid cooling and micro‑fluidic cooling will gain attention. Gelsinger disclosed that Intel is currently investing in several related technology developments.
Semiconductor competition is shifting toward system‑level architectures

Gelsinger also called on the industry to pay attention to the trend of the semiconductor market moving toward system‑level architectures. He pointed out that Nvidia and AMD are now integrating GPUs, CPUs, networking components and software into complete rack systems and offering holistic solutions to customers.

He said future competition will no longer be about single‑chip performance ratios, but will require handling compute loads at the full‑rack level, providing customized solutions based on customer needs, and collaborating closely with customers. He also revealed that Intel will announce related news in the substrate area.

Discussing Intel’s relationship with Nvidia (NVDA-US), Gelsinger said Intel will continue to maintain cooperation with the company. Nvidia is currently both a major shareholder of Intel and a key competitor in the AI chip market.
He noted that no single company can cover all business domains; the key is to focus on areas where it truly has an advantage while partnering with other firms to jointly drive industry development.

items.title: 「我們活在同個世界？」 貝森特聽證會遭民主黨砲轟：美債5%、房貸破7%、油價破百還敢稱「偉大復甦」？
items.title_en: "We Live in the Same World?" Biden Hearing Slammed by Democrats: 5% US Treasury Yields, Mortgage Rates Over 7%, Oil Prices Over $100 Yet Still Call It a "Great Recovery"?
paras: 美國期中選舉倒數幾週之際，美國財長貝森特出席眾議院金融服務委員會聽證會，這場原定聚焦IMF監督的例行會議，迅速演變為一場針對川普政府經濟治理的全面「政治審判」。民主黨議員圍繞飆升的美債殖利率、油價破百及民眾生活成本，對貝森特發動猛烈質詢，貝森特則堅稱經濟基本面強勁，並強調川普政府正致力於削減赤字以穩定市場。
聽證會的火藥味在開場不久便達到頂點。民主黨議員集中火力質疑貝森特，在10年期美債殖利率升破5%、30年期房貸利率突破7%的背景下，為何仍堅稱川普的經濟政策是一場「偉大復甦」。
麻州民主黨眾議員Ayanna Pressley直指貝森特「脫離現實」。她表示，當普通美國家庭正承受能源、住房及借貸成本持續攀升之苦時，貝森特在電視上說的「復甦」景象與民眾的日常體驗形成殘酷反差，並質疑他是否與選民「生活在不同的現實中」。
債市動盪是本次聽證的核心議題。眾議院金融服務委員會民主黨領袖Maxine Waters指出，儘管美國財政部採取了包括回購在內的干預措施，美債仍面臨拋售壓力。
數據顯示，10年期美債殖利率周二(15日)一度觸及2007年來的最高水位，30年期房貸利率也重返7%上方。
Waters強調，這已不僅是華爾街的數字遊戲，高利率正透過房貸、車貸及企業融資成本，實質性地壓垮實體經濟。
面對民主黨對債券回購政策「失效」的指控，貝森特提出一種「反事實推論」辯論道：「若非財政部介入，長期殖利率可能會攀升得更高。」他也列舉近期兩場過去20年來最成功的國債拍賣，證明市場需求依然存在。
然而，貝森特也坦承，財政赤字是推高長期殖利率的關鍵因素。他並透露，財政部正推進減赤計畫，試圖透過改善財政前景來降低市場要求的「期限溢價」，從而緩解債市壓力。
隨著美伊衝突升溫，國際油價再次破百，這讓能源議題在選前變得極為敏感。目前美國普通汽油均價已升至每加侖4.32美元，較去年同期大漲1.14美元，柴油價格更是飆升至6.23美元。
民主黨議員試圖將高油價歸咎於川普政府對伊朗的強硬制裁政策，認為地緣政治的冒險主義正在直接掏空選民的錢包，貝森特則堅持其強硬立場，強調對伊朗的極限施壓是維護美國國安的必要之舉。
分析師指出，高油價不僅推高通膨預期，還強化了市場對Fed維持高利率甚至進一步升息的擔憂，形成了「高油價—高通膨—高利率」的惡性循環。
除傳統經濟議題外，AI則意外成為聽證會的焦點。近期，Anthropic、OpenAI等企業高層呼籲加強監管，但貝森特的表態顯示川普政府的另一種思路。
貝森特還特別提到中國AI模型Kimi的安全事件，並明確表示，政府不應以安全為名給予大型AI實驗室「責任豁免」，因這可能讓少數巨頭利用監管建立壁壘，形成「監管俘獲」(regulatory capture)。
他並強調，美國需要發展更多開源模型，防止大型實驗室壟斷市場。這一表態呼應了川普陣營對大型科技公司試圖透過複雜規則削弱競爭對手的批評，顯示AI政策優先級正從「是否監管」轉向「如何防止壟斷」。
儘管聽證會氣氛激烈，貝森特與共和黨議員仍試圖轉移焦點至經濟政績。他們指出，標普500指數自川普第二任期以來累計上漲約27%，失業率維持在4.1%的低位。貝森特特別強調，收入最低25%勞動者的工資增速已快於最高收入群體，且已有超過6400萬份報稅表申請了去年的稅收減免。
貝森特總結說：「不能僅憑近期的油價和債券波動來否定整體經濟表現。」
然而，隨著11月期中大選逼近，這場聽證會暴露出的債務隱憂與生活成本危機，無疑將成為美國選民衡量川普經濟學成敗的關鍵砝碼。
paras_en: In the final weeks before the U.S. midterm elections, Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen appeared before the House Financial Services Committee. What was supposed to be a routine hearing focused on IMF oversight quickly turned into a full‑blown political trial of the Trump administration’s economic management. Democratic lawmakers launched a fierce interrogation of Yellen over soaring Treasury yields, oil prices above $100 a barrel and rising living costs, while Yellen insisted that the economic fundamentals remain strong and stressed that the Trump administration is working to cut deficits to stabilize markets.

The tension peaked early in the hearing. Democratic members zeroed in on Yellen, asking why she still described the Trump economic agenda as a “great recovery” even as the 10‑year Treasury yield had broken past 5% and 30‑year mortgage rates had climbed above 7%.

Massachusetts Democrat Ayanna Pressley accused Yellen of being “out of touch with reality.” She said ordinary American families are feeling the pain of rising energy, housing and borrowing costs, and that the “recovery” Yellen touts on television is a stark contrast to everyday experience, questioning whether she lives in a different reality than her constituents.

Bond‑market turmoil was the core issue of the hearing. House Financial Services Committee Democratic leader Maxine Waters noted that despite Treasury’s intervention measures, including buybacks, Treasuries are still under selling pressure.
Data showed the 10‑year Treasury yield briefly hit its highest level since 2007 on Tuesday the 15th, while 30‑year mortgage rates also rose back above 7%.
Waters emphasized that this is no longer just a Wall Street numbers game; high rates are crushing the real economy through mortgage, auto‑loan and corporate‑financing costs.

Facing Democratic accusations that the bond‑buyback policy had failed, Yellen offered a counter‑factual argument: “If the Treasury had not intervened, long‑term yields could have risen even higher.” She also cited two of the most successful Treasury auctions in the past 20 years to show that demand remains robust.

However, Yellen admitted that the fiscal deficit is a key driver of higher long‑term yields. She disclosed that the Treasury is advancing a deficit‑reduction plan aimed at improving the fiscal outlook and lowering the market’s required term premium, thereby easing pressure on the bond market.

As the U.S.–Iran conflict intensifies, international oil prices have again topped $100 a barrel, making energy a highly sensitive pre‑election issue. The average U.S. gasoline price has risen to $4.32 per gallon, up $1.14 from a year ago, while diesel has surged to $6.23.

Democratic lawmakers tried to blame the high oil price on the Trump administration’s tough sanctions on Iran, arguing that geopolitical adventurism is directly emptying voters’ wallets. Yellen held fast to the hard‑line stance, stressing that maximum pressure on Iran is essential for U.S. national security.

Analysts note that high oil prices not only lift inflation expectations but also reinforce market fears that the Fed will keep rates high or even raise them further, creating a vicious “high‑oil‑high‑inflation‑high‑rates” cycle.

Beyond traditional economic topics, AI unexpectedly became a focal point of the hearing. Recently, executives from Anthropic, OpenAI and other firms have called for tighter regulation, but Yellen’s remarks revealed a different Trump‑era perspective.

Yellen specifically referenced a safety incident involving China’s AI model Kimi and made clear that the government should not grant “liability exemptions” to large AI labs in the name of safety, as that could allow a few giants to use regulation to build barriers—a classic case of regulatory capture.

She stressed that the United States needs to develop more open‑source models to prevent large labs from monopolizing the market. This stance echoes criticism from the Trump camp that big tech uses complex rules to weaken competitors, indicating that AI policy priority is shifting from “whether to regulate” to “how to prevent monopolies.”

Despite the heated atmosphere, Yellen and Republican members tried to shift the focus back to economic achievements. They pointed out that the S&P 500 has risen about 27% since the start of Trump’s second term and that unemployment remains low at 4.1%. Yellen highlighted that wage growth for the lowest‑quartile workers has outpaced that of the highest earners, and more than 64 million tax returns have claimed last year’s tax relief.
Yellen concluded, “We cannot dismiss the overall economic performance based solely on recent oil price spikes and bond market volatility.”

However, with the November midterm election looming, the debt‑related worries and cost‑of‑living crisis exposed in this hearing are sure to become a key metric for voters evaluating the success or failure of Trump‑era economics.

items.title: 散戶熱追資安題材 但做法是買選擇權並拋售現貨
items.title_en: Retail Investors Chase Cybersecurity Theme but Buy Options While Selling Stocks
paras: 近期全球資訊安全類股迎來強勁反彈，Global X 資安 ETF(BUG-US)更錄得有紀錄以來最大的單日漲幅。然而，根據研調機構 Vanda Analytics 的最新報告，散戶投資人在這波行情中雖大幅增加資安股的選擇權交易，卻對個股現貨維持淨賣出，呈現「熱炒選擇權、冷落正股」的特殊現象。
在法人布局方面，法人機構在行情大漲前的持倉相對輕淡。截至 9 月 14 日，Vanda 針對資安類股組合計算的法人買賣權比率分數(Call-Put Ratio Score)降至 -0.27，低於 2017 年以來的歷史中位數，且遠低於今年 1 月的 +0.84，顯示法人對買權的需求自初夏以來便逐漸降溫。
相較之下，散戶的參與極度集中於衍生性商品。過去 5 個交易日中，散戶在 CrowdStrike(CRWD-US)、Palo Alto Networks(PANW-US)與 Zscaler(ZS-US)等資安龍頭股的價外買權(Out-of-the-money Call)成交量，已躍升至歷史前 2% 的高位(第 98 個百分位數)。
然而，現貨資金流向卻背道而馳，散戶在前一交易日分別淨賣出 640 萬美元的 Palo Alto Networks 以及 350 萬美元的 Zscaler 股票。
針對此一市場結構，Vanda Analytics 創新長兼全球市場策略師Viraj Patel指出，數據證明散戶投資人主要利用短天期選擇權參與資安股的飆漲行情，而非直接重新建立現貨個股部位。
Patel認為，這意味著如果資安類股的反彈趨勢持續，目前散戶偏低的現貨持倉，將為未來現貨買盤的回補與擴增留出潛在空間。
paras_en: Recent global cybersecurity stocks have seen a strong rebound, with the Global X Cybersecurity ETF (BUG-US) posting its biggest single‑day gain on record. However, according to the latest report from research firm Vanda Analytics, retail investors have dramatically increased their options trading in cyber stocks during this rally, while maintaining net selling of the underlying shares, creating a “hot options, cold stocks” phenomenon.

On the institutional side, institutions held relatively light positions before the market surge. As of September 14, Vanda’s Call‑Put Ratio Score for the cybersecurity stock basket fell to –0.27, below the historical median since 2017 and far lower than the +0.84 recorded in January, indicating that institutional demand for calls has been cooling since early summer.

In contrast, retail participation is extremely concentrated in derivatives. Over the past five trading days, retail investors’ out‑of‑the‑money call volume on cyber‑security leaders such as CrowdStrike (CRWD‑US), Palo Alto Networks (PANW‑US) and Zscaler (ZS‑US) has jumped into the top 2 % historically (the 98th percentile).

Yet the flow of cash into the underlying stocks moves in the opposite direction: retail investors net‑sold $6.4 million of Palo Alto Networks and $3.5 million of Zscaler shares on the prior trading day.

Commenting on this market structure, Vanda Analytics’ Chief Innovation Officer and Global Market Strategist Viraj Patel said the data show retail investors are mainly using short‑dated options to ride the cyber‑stock rally rather than rebuilding outright equity positions.
Patel believes this implies that if the cybersecurity rebound continues, the currently low retail equity holdings could leave room for future buying pressure and an expansion of spot positions.

items.title: Fed升息早被市場猜中！華許說錯一句話才是真正風險
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)周三(16日)料將升息1碼(25個基點)，為2023年以來首度升息，將聯邦資金利率目標區間上調至3.75%至4.00%。不過，由於市場預期升息機率已超過90%，政策決定本身可能不會帶來太大意外，Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)如何說明此次行動，以及是否暗示後續仍有升息空間，反而將成為牽動全球金融市場的關鍵。
這也將是華許接掌Fed後首次調整貨幣政策，升息決定與美國總統川普原先期待背道而馳。川普提名華許時曾表示，希望他帶領Fed降息，近期更威脅稱，若Fed不降低借貸成本，將祭出新一輪進口關稅。
然而，美國通膨持續高於Fed的2%目標，加上全球借貸成本攀升，市場也質疑華許是否有意願抵抗白宮壓力，使本周升息幾乎已成定局。投資人如今最關注的，是華許能否說服債券市場，相信Fed有決心壓制已連續逾5年高於目標的通膨。

升息是否獲一致支持成關鍵訊號

Fed將於美東時間周三下午2時公布利率決策，並同步發布最新季度經濟預測及利率點陣圖。PGIM美國首席經濟學家Robert Sockin表示，若本次升息獲得決策官員一致支持，將釋出強烈訊號；若經濟預測顯示官員預期今年還會再升息，甚至2027年仍有進一步行動，政策立場將更加明確。
Sockin預期Fed可能共升息3次。他認為，華許上月在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會的說法已為本次行動鋪路，即若通膨未能以足夠速度回落，Fed就還有更多工作要做。
相較之下，若華許將此次升息形容為幅度不大的政策微調，並在記者會上流露鴿派態度，市場反應可能不佳。投資人恐怕會懷疑Fed抗通膨的決心，進而拋售長天期美債，導致殖利率不降反升。
Fed官員6月公布的預測仍存在明顯分歧，19名官員中有9人認為，2026年底前至少需要升息1碼，另有9人預估利率可能維持不變或下降1碼；不喜歡點陣圖制度的華許，則未提交個人預測。
不過，支持升息的聲音此後持續增加。7月28日至29日的決策會議已有3名官員主張升息，另有多名官員表示，除非通膨很快出現降溫跡象，否則已準備採取行動。

通膨居高不下 油價與關稅再添風險

Fed偏好的通膨指標個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數，6月及7月年增率均達3.7%，遠高於2%目標，9月30日公布的最新數據也預料不會出現明顯改善。
雖然許多經濟學家仍認為通膨壓力最終將逐步減弱，但近期國際油價重新站上每桶100美元，加上川普宣布對加拿大加徵新關稅，並威脅推出更多進口稅，以及人工智慧(AI)支出熱潮持續支撐美國經濟成長，都讓通膨上行風險升高。
華許在傑克森霍爾演說中也坦言，決策官員必須確信基礎通膨正明確且以足夠速度朝政策目標邁進，但近期數據尚未顯示通膨趨勢已獲得實質改善。
市場因此認為，此次升息不僅是對當前通膨的回應，也是華許建立抗通膨公信力的重要考驗。一旦Fed在市場已有高度預期的情況下按兵不動，可能加深投資人對華許屈服於政治壓力的疑慮。

華許若不夠鷹 美債殖利率恐不降反升

全球債市走勢也正將Fed推向更高利率。美國10年期公債殖利率周二突破5%，升至19年新高。愈來愈多經濟學家與投資人認為，全球可能已進入借貸成本長期走高的新環境，即使排除通膨及發債風險等因素，均衡利率本身也可能正在上升。
這代表Fed即使只是希望維持相同程度的貨幣緊縮，短期政策利率仍可能需要進一步調高。包括華許在內的多名Fed官員也認為，目前政策對經濟需求的抑制作用並不強。
這或許也是川普政府可能默許Fed升息的原因。若Fed意外打破市場已充分反映的升息預期，可能損害華許的抗通膨信譽，迫使投資人要求更高的通膨風險補償，反而推升長期殖利率。10年期美債殖利率又是房貸等消費信貸的重要定價基準，借貸成本居高不下，恐衝擊共和黨在11月期中選舉力保國會控制權的努力。
不過，渣打銀行(Standard Chartered)分析師John Davies與Steve Englander主張，本周仍應按兵不動，認為市場在新增數據有限的情況下形成「回音室效應」，不斷推高升息預期，而Fed多等待一段時間的代價其實很低。
布魯金斯學會(Brookings Institution)資深研究員Robin Brooks則指出，市場目前已反映明年6月前升息4次，華許勢必在記者會上不斷被追問對此有何看法。若其發言比市場預期鴿派，即使Fed已透過升息試圖穩定殖利率，仍可能引發長天期美債新一輪賣壓。
因此，本次會議真正的風險不在Fed是否升息，而在華許會把它描述為一次性行動、後續升息循環的第一步，或是完全取決於數據的政策調整。升息早已被市場視為定局，華許說出口的每一句話，可能比升息本身更具影響力。

items.title: 〈台幣〉Fed升息預期升溫！連5貶探近1月新低 面臨32元保衛戰
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations Heat Up! Five Consecutive Declines, Near One‑Month Low, Facing a NT$32 Defence Battle
paras: 新台幣兌美元今(16)日走勢震盪，市場對美國聯準會(Fed)升息預期升溫，加上國際油價續揚推升通膨疑慮、美債殖利率突破5%，主要亞幣持續承壓，新台幣早盤一度貶破31.9元關卡，面臨 32 元保衛戰，隨後雖受台股反彈帶動強勢翻紅，但終場仍敵不過美元買盤，收在31.888元，貶值4分，呈現連 5 貶，探近 1 個月新低，台北外匯市場成交金額縮至 13.94 億美元，市場轉趨觀望。
新台幣今日以31.87元開出後，早盤隨亞幣走低，最低下探至31.932元。不過上午10點過後，隨著台股拉升，匯價出現急拉並轉升，高點一度觸及31.79元，高低波動逾1角，終場則再度翻貶以31.888元作收。前一交易日新台幣在美元強勢與外資匯出下，盤中曾重貶逾2角，尾盤經央行進場調節後收在31.688元，今日則呈現先升後貶的洗盤格局。
根據央行統計主要貨幣今日表現，美元指數微幅拉回0.03%，亞幣普遍承壓，其中以韓元重挫0.51%最為劇烈，新台幣貶值0.13%，日元及新加坡幣分別走貶0.06%與0.05%；人民幣則展現韌性，逆勢升值0.10%。
台積電今天盤中強勢填息，台股一度上漲超過 560 點，不過，適逢台指期結算，買盤相對謹慎，加權指數終場收在 45848.9 點，上漲337.41點。外資賣超 179.8 億元，投信買超 95.74 億元，自營商則賣超 129.74 億元。
匯銀人士分析，各大研究機構已針對Fed政策決策進行沙盤推演，市場已大致消化升息1碼的預期，因此若最終結果符合預期，美元不致出現劇烈劇動。然而，市場焦點將轉向Fed會後聲明與主席談話是否釋出鷹派訊號，若政策態度偏鷹，恐引發重啟升息循環的討論並觸發市場重新定價，屆時美債殖利率與美元將再獲得支撐，亞幣勢必面臨更沉重的貶值壓力。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar against the US dollar fluctuated today (the 16th), as market expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes intensified, international oil prices kept rising fueling inflation concerns, and US Treasury yields broke the 5% mark, keeping major Asian currencies under pressure. The NT$ briefly slipped past the NT$31.9 barrier in early trading, prompting a defence of the NT$32 level; although it later rallied strongly on the back of a rebound in the Taiwan stock market, it ultimately could not withstand dollar buying pressure and closed at NT$31.888, down 0.04, marking a fifth straight decline and approaching a one‑month low. Turnover in Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market shrank to US$1.394 billion as market sentiment turned cautious.

After opening at NT$31.87, the NT$ fell with other Asian currencies in early trading, reaching a low of NT$31.932. However, after 10 a.m., as the Taiwan stock market rose, the exchange rate surged sharply and turned higher, briefly touching NT$31.79, with a swing of more than 0.1 NT$ during the session. It ended the day back in decline at NT$31.888. On the previous trading day, the NT$ had been heavily pressured by a strong dollar and foreign‑capital outflows, sinking more than 0.2 NT$ intraday before the central bank intervened at the close to bring it to NT$31.688. Today’s pattern was a wash‑trade of an initial rise followed by a decline.

According to the central bank’s statistics on major currencies today, the US Dollar Index slipped marginally by 0.03%. Asian currencies were broadly under pressure, with the Korean won plunging the most at –0.51%. The New Taiwan dollar depreciated 0.13%, while the Japanese yen and Singapore dollar fell 0.06% and 0.05% respectively; the Chinese renminbi showed resilience, appreciating 0.10% against the dollar.

TSMC posted strong earnings during the session, lifting the Taiwan stock index by more than 560 points. However, with the Taiwan futures contract settlement occurring, buying was relatively cautious and the weighted index closed at 45,848.9 points, up 337.41 points. Foreign investors sold NT$17.98 billion, investment trusts bought NT$9.574 billion, and proprietary traders sold NT$12.974 billion.

Analysts from foreign exchange banks said that major research institutions have already run scenario analyses on Fed policy decisions, and the market has largely priced in a one‑point rate hike. Therefore, if the final outcome matches expectations, the dollar is unlikely to experience extreme volatility. The market’s focus will shift to the Fed’s post‑meeting statement and the chair’s remarks to see if any hawkish signals are conveyed. If policy stance leans hawkish, it could reignite discussions of restarting the rate‑hike cycle and trigger a market repricing, which would again support US Treasury yields and the dollar, putting even heavier depreciation pressure on Asian currencies.

items.title: Fed升息美元會大漲？歷史數據：6次升息週期有一半沒走強
items.title_en: Will the Fed's Rate Hike Trigger a Big Dollar Rally? Historical Data Shows Only Half of Six Hike Cycles Saw a Strong Dollar
paras: 與聯準會(Fed)會議日期掛鉤的利率互換合約顯示，交易員認為本周升息幾乎是板上釘釘。不過，外匯市場更關心的是，聯準會重新啟動升息後，美元指數是否會迎來新一波升值行情。
利率互換合約顯示，交易員認為聯準會此次將利率從目前的3.5%，上調25個基點至3.75%的機率約94%。
隨著9月升息預期快速升溫並逐漸被市場消化，美元指數過去一周明顯走高，最近匯價在99.70附近，再度逼近100大關。
嘉盛集團在最新報告中指出，市場目前普遍認為，聯準會此次行動不會只是一次性的利率調整，而可能代表新一輪實質緊縮週期的開始。這與今年稍早市場預期聯準會可能多次降息的情況形成明顯反轉。
然而，歷史經驗顯示，聯準會升息並不一定會直接推動美元走強。雖然短期利率可能明顯上升，但首次升息後美元走勢仍存在高度不確定性。
從降息預期轉向升息週期
嘉盛集團指出，在聯準會9月聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議前，市場對升息的定價已超過90%，幾乎意味著升息已成定局。若聯準會意外維持利率不變，市場可能重新評估其政策可信度，並可能引發美元及長天期美債殖利率劇烈波動
市場目前也認為，此次升息不太可能像1997年一樣僅是單次調整。在美伊戰爭爆發前，市場原本仍預期聯準會今年可能多次降息，但隨後預期方向完全逆轉，目前市場已開始反映未來多次升息可能性，截至明年6月的殖利率曲線甚至顯示，市場預期總計可能升息四次。
若這項預期成真，將代表聯準會政策方向完全逆轉，不僅結束前一階段寬鬆政策，最終利率高度甚至可能超越市場原先預期。
六次升息週期 美元未必同步上漲
為觀察升息對市場的影響，嘉盛集團回顧自1994年以來，首次升息發生在前一次降息至少六個月後的案例，共篩選出1994年、1997年、1999年、2004年、2015年與2022年六個升息週期。
分析顯示，除了1997年聯準會僅進行一次25個基點升息外，其餘週期均代表更廣泛的升息循環啟動。
從短期利率來看，2年期美債殖利率通常會提前反映政策轉向。嘉盛集團指出，在上述六個週期中，首次升息時的2年期美債殖利率都高於三個月前水準，顯示市場通常會在聯準會正式升息前，提前消化緊縮預期。
此次市場也呈現類似情況，隨著升息預期升溫，2年期美債殖利率持續走高。
不過，首次升息後，2年期美債殖利率走勢則有所分歧。在較大規模緊縮週期中，例如1994年、2004年與2022年，殖利率隨著聯準會持續升息而進一步攀升。
美元與升息關聯並非固定
相較於短期債券殖利率，美元走勢更難預測。嘉盛集團指出，雖然過往緊縮週期前夕，美元通常會跟隨短期殖利率上升，但歷史數據顯示，即使短期利率持續攀升，美元指數仍可能下跌，代表升息與美元升值之間並不存在必然關係。
其中，1994年與1999年兩個升息週期，被嘉盛集團認為與當前市場環境更具可比性。當時聯準會都是在利率接近中性水準後開始收緊政策，與2004年、2015年及2022年面臨緊急升息壓力的環境有所不同。
在1994年與1999年週期中，雖然2年期美債殖利率持續走高，但美元指數初期卻呈現相反走勢。尤其1994年，即使聯準會後續展開激進緊縮，美元仍明顯走弱，顯示單靠升息不足以支撐美元行情。
1999年的情況也受到市場關注，因為當時聯準會是在經歷「保險性降息」後重新轉向緊縮，與目前市場從寬鬆預期轉向升息預期的背景有一定相似性。
此外，當時網路科技投資浪潮興起，如今則是AI投資熱潮推動企業資本支出，兩者均處於重大科技轉型階段。
美元短線仍受利率連動影響
嘉盛集團指出，目前美國短債殖利率與美元指數之間存在異常強烈的正相關關係。兩者4週、8週及12週相關係數均約在+0.78至+0.79，其中8週相關係數已位於1992年以來歷史讀數第94百分位附近，12週相關係數更接近第97百分位。
從歷史角度來看，聯準會首次升息後，2年期美債殖利率通常仍可能走高，因此若目前美元與短端利率的高度連動關係持續，美元確實面臨上行壓力。
但嘉盛集團也提醒，市場關聯性會隨時間改變，過去已有多次短端殖利率上升、美元卻未同步走強的案例。因此，即使目前兩者關聯度處於高檔，也不能直接推論聯準會升息必然帶動美元持續升值。
升息類型決定美元方向
國信證券也認為，聯準會升息並不代表美元必然上漲。該機構依據美國經濟、通膨與就業狀況建立抗通膨壓力指數，將升息週期分為抗通膨型升息與預防型升息。
研究顯示，在預防型升息週期中，美元指數平均下跌3.5%；而在抗通膨型升息週期中，美元指數平均上漲6.3%。
這代表若升息主要是因應高通膨壓力，較高利率維持時間與避險需求可能更有利支撐美元；若升息只是政策正常化，美元未必會同步走強。
因此，聯準會啟動升息後，美元是否大幅升值，關鍵並不只在於利率本身，而在於市場如何解讀升息背景、後續政策路徑，以及美國經濟與通膨環境是否持續支撐美元需求。
paras_en: The interest‑rate swap contracts tied to Fed meeting dates show traders view a rate hike this week as almost certain. However, the FX market is more focused on whether the dollar index will start a new appreciation wave once the Fed restarts tightening.
Swap data indicate traders assign about a 94% probability that the Fed will raise rates from the current 3.5% to 3.75% by a 25‑basis‑point move.
As September‑hike expectations heated up and were gradually priced in, the dollar index rose noticeably over the past week, hovering around 99.70 and again edging toward the 100 mark.

IG Group notes that the market now broadly believes this move will not be a one‑off adjustment but could signal the start of a new substantive tightening cycle, a sharp reversal from earlier expectations of multiple rate cuts this year.
Nevertheless, history shows a Fed hike does not automatically strengthen the dollar. While short‑term rates may jump, the dollar’s path after the first hike remains highly uncertain.
From Rate‑Cut Expectations to a Hike Cycle

IG points out that before the September FOMC, the market had priced in a hike at over 90%, essentially making a hike a foregone conclusion. If the Fed were to hold rates unexpectedly, credibility could be reassessed and could spark sharp swings in the dollar and long‑term Treasury yields.

The market also thinks this hike is unlikely to be a single 25‑bp move like in 1997. Before the Iraq war, analysts still expected multiple cuts this year, but that view flipped completely. The curve now reflects the possibility of several hikes, with the yield curve out to June next year implying up to four hikes in total.
If that scenario materialises, it would represent a full reversal of policy, ending the previous accommodative phase and potentially pushing rates higher than originally forecast.
Six Hike Cycles – The Dollar Does Not Always Follow
To gauge the impact of hikes, IG reviewed six cycles since 1994 where the first hike came at least six months after the previous cut: 1994, 1997, 1999, 2004, 2015 and 2022.
The analysis shows that, except for the lone 25‑bp hike in 1997, each cycle marked the start of a broader tightening wave.

From a short‑term rate perspective, the 2‑year Treasury yield usually moves ahead of policy shifts. IG found that in all six cycles, the 2‑year yield was higher at the first hike than three months earlier, indicating markets typically digest tightening expectations before the Fed acts.
The current market mirrors that pattern, with the 2‑year yield climbing as hike expectations rise.
However, after the first hike the 2‑year yield’s trajectory diverges. In larger‑scale cycles such as 1994, 2004 and 2022, yields kept climbing as the Fed kept raising rates.
The Dollar‑Hike Link Is Not Fixed

Compared with short‑term yields, the dollar’s path is harder to predict. IG notes that while the dollar often rose with short‑term yields before past tightening cycles, historical data show the dollar index can still fall even as short‑term rates keep climbing, meaning a hike does not guarantee dollar strength.

IG considers the 1994 and 1999 cycles most comparable to today. In those periods the Fed began tightening only after rates were near neutral, unlike the emergency‑hike environments of 2004, 2015 and 2022.

During the 1994 and 1999 cycles, the 2‑year yield kept rising but the dollar index initially moved in the opposite direction. Notably in 1994, even as the Fed later pursued aggressive tightening, the dollar weakened, showing that hikes alone cannot sustain a dollar rally.

The 1999 episode also draws attention because the Fed shifted back to tightening after a “insurance‑rate cut,” a backdrop somewhat similar to today’s shift from easing expectations to hike expectations.
Moreover, the late‑1990s saw a boom in internet‑tech investment, just as today AI investment is driving corporate cap‑ex – both periods of major tech transformation.
The Dollar Still Tracks Short‑Term Rates in the Near Term

IG points out that currently the correlation between short‑term US yields and the dollar index is unusually strong, with 4‑week, 8‑week and 12‑week coefficients around +0.78 to +0.79. The 8‑week coefficient sits near the 94th percentile of readings since 1992, and the 12‑week near the 97th percentile.
Historically, after a first Fed hike the 2‑year yield often continues to rise, so if the tight link between the dollar and short‑term rates persists, the dollar does face upward pressure.

But IG cautions that these relationships evolve; there have been several instances where short‑term yields rose while the dollar did not keep pace. Hence a high current correlation does not prove that a Fed hike will inevitably lift the dollar.
Hike Type Determines Dollar Direction

Guotai Junan Securities also believes a Fed hike does not guarantee a stronger dollar. The firm builds an anti‑inflation pressure index from US economic, inflation and employment data and classifies hikes into anti‑inflation and preventive types.
Research shows that in preventive‑type cycles the dollar index falls on average 3.5%, whereas in anti‑inflation cycles it rises about 6.3%.

This suggests that if hikes are driven by high inflation pressure, longer‑lasting higher rates and safe‑haven demand may better support the dollar; if hikes are merely policy normalisation, the dollar may not rise in tandem.

Therefore, after the Fed starts tightening, whether the dollar appreciates sharply depends not just on the rate level itself but on how markets interpret the hike’s backdrop, the subsequent policy path, and whether the US economy and inflation continue to underpin dollar demand.

items.title: 連12月成長！晶片出貨激增撐起日本8月出口　但增速放緩貿易逆差續擴大
items.title_en: 12 Consecutive Months of Growth! Chip Shipments Surge Boost Japan's August Exports, Yet Growth Slows and Trade Deficit Expands
paras: 最新數據顯示，日本8月出口額年增19.3%，連12月走增且高於經濟學家預估的18.4%，但較7月23.2%的增幅有所回落，其中半導體和晶片製造設備出貨量激增。不過，受原油價格居高不下與日元貶值雙重擠壓，進口增幅更大，貿易逆差擴大至1.1兆日元，7月經修正後的逆差為6383億日元，為連續第4個月出現貿易赤字。
根據日本財務省今(16)日公布的數據，日本對美國出口成長24.9%，對中國出口成長20.6%，對歐洲出口成長11%。出口成長的核心引擎是半導體相關產品。日本8月半導體等電子零件出口整體激增52%，其中對中國出口額翻倍，面向美國和歐盟的半導體製造設備出口也成長超過100%。汽車出口雖保持成長，但成長速度已慢於前幾個月。
進口方面，日本8月進口額年增28%，高於預期的26.3%，其中原油進口金額成長約59%，而進口數量僅微增3.6%。 8月布蘭特原油均價約每桶88美元，而日元兌美元平均匯率為160.64，較前一年貶值8.7%，顯著推高進口成本。
上週，隨著荷姆茲海峽攻擊事件增加、美國與伊朗都在為這場戰爭長期化佈局，布蘭特已漲破每桶100美元。日元兌美元自9月以來已升值超過3%，成為同期表現最好的亞洲貨幣。雖然如此，日元今日在亞洲匯市早盤兌美元匯率於155.18附近交易，低於10年平均值126.55。
伊藤忠綜合研究所首席經濟學家武田淳指出，高油價正持續擴大貿易逆差，隨著油價突破每桶100美元，日本將更難恢復貿易順差。
為分散風險，日本正降低對中東石油的依賴。8月自美國進口原油金額暴增超過1000%，達4000億日元，從中東進口額僅增3.7%，進口量驟降約31%。
經濟學家認為，在AI等尖端技術需求的持續拉動下，日本出口前景依然光明，可望抵禦部分外部成本壓力。
paras_en: The latest data show that Japan's August export value rose 19.3% year‑on‑year, marking the 12th consecutive month of growth and beating economists' forecast of 18.4%, though the pace slowed from July's 23.2% increase, driven by a surge in semiconductor and chip‑making equipment shipments. However, higher crude oil prices and a weaker yen together pushed import growth even higher, widening the trade deficit to ¥1.1 trillion; the revised July deficit was ¥638.3 billion, marking the fourth straight month of a trade loss.

According to data released by the Ministry of Finance today (the 16th), Japan’s exports to the United States grew 24.9%, to China 20.6%, and to Europe 11%. The core engine of export growth was semiconductor‑related products. Overall exports of semiconductors and other electronic components jumped 52% in August, with exports to China doubling, and exports of semiconductor manufacturing equipment to the United States and the EU each rising by more than 100%. Automobile exports continued to grow, but at a slower pace than in previous months.

On the import side, Japan’s August import value rose 28% year‑on‑year, above the expected 26.3%, with crude oil import value up about 59% while import volume edged up only 3.6%. The average Brent crude price in August was about $88 per barrel, and the yen averaged ¥160.64 per dollar, a depreciation of 8.7% from a year earlier, which significantly raised import costs.

Last week, as attacks in the Hormuz Strait increased and both the United States and Iran positioned for a protracted conflict, Brent crude broke the $100‑per‑barrel mark. Since September, the yen has appreciated more than 3% against the dollar, making it the best‑performing Asian currency over the same period. Nevertheless, the yen traded around ¥155.18 per dollar in early Asian market trading today, below the 10‑year average of ¥126.55.

Takeda Jun, chief economist at Itochu Research Institute, noted that high oil prices are continuously widening the trade deficit, and with oil prices breaching $100 per barrel, Japan will find it even harder to return to a trade surplus.

To diversify risk, Japan is reducing its reliance on Middle‑East oil. In August, imports of crude oil from the United States surged by more than 1,000% to ¥400 billion, while imports from the Middle East rose only 3.7% and volumes fell sharply by about 31%.
Economists believe that, driven by sustained demand for cutting‑edge technologies such as AI, Japan’s export outlook remains bright and can help offset some of the external cost pressures.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元創兩周新高 交易員為預期中的升息做準備
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Hits Two-Week High as Traders Prepare for Expected Rate Hike
paras: 美元周二(15日)升至兩周來最高，聯準會(Fed)即將公布最新利率決策，外匯市場參與者正為市場普遍預期的升息做好準備。美國公債殖利率大幅上升，進一步推高借貸成本，油價則延續本周以來漲勢。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.3%，報99.66，為9月1日以來最高。
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前預期聯準會聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)周三宣布升息 25個基點的機率高達94.5%，遠高於一周前的59%。一般而言，較高的利率環境往往有利於美元走強。
升息預期之所以大幅升溫，主要受到幾項因素推動，包括美國債券市場持續遭到猛烈拋售、油價飆升引發通膨疑慮、最近公布的美國就業市場與通膨數據，以及聯準會官員近期越來越偏向鷹派的評論。
美國10年期公債殖利率周二上升4.7個基點，來到5.008%，創下2007年4月以來最高水準。而30年期公債殖利率也創下超過24年來新高。
這波美國債券遭拋售的另一個原因，是市場開始擔心投入數十億美元建設AI基礎設施，以及美國財政債務持續膨脹所帶來的影響。
與此同時，油價周二繼續走高。布蘭特原油(Brent)期貨最新上漲2.6%，來到每桶108.40美元。美國西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨則上漲4.1%，來到每桶105.56美元。
此次油價進一步上漲，是受到相關報導影響，包括沙烏地阿拉伯紅海一座重要港口的石油裝載作業暫停及利比亞停止三座油田的營運。這些供應中斷的消息，加深了市場對原油供應的擔憂。
現在市場關注的焦點，是聯準會是否真的會宣布三年多來首次升息。尤其是美國總統川普正向聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)施壓，希望聯準會降息，且美國11月也即將舉行期中選舉。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家 José Torres表示，「市場目前已準備好迎接明天的升息。升息可以透過展現聯準會打擊高於目標通膨的決心，降低市場對物價壓力的預期。」
他認為，在扣除食品與能源後，目前成本因素所帶來的通膨大致維持在2%出頭的低位，因此，溫和的升息25個基點是合理的。如此一來，華爾街就可以開始思考：這次升息會不會是「升一次就停」？
Torres進一步表示，這次升息可能導致殖利率曲線在當天結束時變得更加平坦，因為貨幣政策上的紀律，正與一個現實發生衝突——更高的燃料成本，目前還未明顯推升整體經濟的物價。
這也是為什麼整體消費者通膨與核心消費者通膨之間，目前仍維持約100個基點的差距：整體通膨為3.4%，但核心通膨在2.4%。
Torres補充說，對看多美元或其他資產的投資人來說，另一個值得注意的因素是：今年較高的原油價格，反而可能對2027年形成有利的基期效應。
換句話說，如果今年油價維持高檔，那麼到了明年，油價的年增率可能比較容易下降，讓華許及其團隊更容易達成2%的通膨目標。
日元回落 市場等待日本升息
另一方面，日元進一步遠離近期高點，周二一度貶至一周多來新低155.12日元兌1美元。這代表日元延續近期的回落走勢。
日元上周才升至152.89兌1美元，創下七個月來新高，如今開始回落，因為市場同樣正在等待日本銀行(BoJ)預計於周五升息。
歐元則徘徊在一個月低點附近。
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%，至1歐元兌1.1540美元。
外匯交易員仍在評估歐元區「停滯性通膨」的風險，以及美元偏鷹所帶來的壓力。
此前歐洲央行(ECB)於上周將借貸成本升息25個基點至2.50%。
